   > Tip: upgrading keeps the factory's type, so plan which machines you want at five slots.
12. **Elite Factory**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:elite_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:elite_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_compressing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_combining_factory)item(mekanism:elite_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:elite_injecting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_infusing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_sawing_factory))` *(after: Advanced Factory)*
   > What: 7 parallel slots. Pair an Elite Purifying or Injecting Factory with your ore line and the bottleneck moves elsewhere.
   > How: upgrade an advanced factory with Elite Control Circuits and Reinforced Alloy (check JEI).
   > Tip: the factory GUI shows each slot's progress; idle slots mean the input line is too slow.
13. **Ultimate Factory**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:ultimate_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_compressing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_combining_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_injecting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_infusing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_sawing_factory))` *(after: Elite Factory)*
   > Nine tasks in one box, all at once. You remember doing many things at once without effort.
   > What: 9 parallel slots, the top of base Mekanism. Mekanism Extras goes further (see the bottom band).
   > How: upgrade an elite factory with Ultimate Control Circuits and Atomic Alloy (check JEI).
   > Tip: add Speed and Energy upgrades: speed raises power use, energy upgrades bring it back down.
14. **Precision Sawmill**: `mekanism:precision_sawmill` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: cuts logs into more planks than hand crafting, often with a bonus of sawdust, and breaks wooden items back down.
   > Chemistry: wood is about 40-50% cellulose (chains of glucose), with hemicellulose and lignin gluing the fibres together. Sawdust is the same polymers, finely divided.
   > How: iron, Infused Alloy, a Basic Control Circuit and a steel casing (check JEI).
   > Tip: sawdust feeds wood gasification in the PRC and the Cardboard Box.
15. **Factories for the Ore Line**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:basic_injecting_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_injecting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:elite_injecting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_injecting_factory))` *(after: Advanced Factory, 4x Ore: Hydrogen Chloride)*
   > What: a Purifying (O₂, 3x) or Injecting (HCl, 4x) Factory runs several ores at once. Ore processing is where factories pay off most.
   > Chemistry: the gas is consumed per operation: oxygen oxidises the ore surface into clumps, hydrogen chloride attacks it into shards. More slots means more gas, so size the separator to match.
   > How: build the factory from a Purification Chamber or Chemical Injection Chamber (both MV in this pack). Any tier and either type counts.
   > Tip: feed the gas into the factory's gas side with pressurized tubes, the same as the single machine.
16. **Combiner**: `mekanism:combiner` *(after: Elite Control Circuit)*
   > What: the Combiner presses a main input together with a second block, for example flint + cobblestone into gravel, or 4 obsidian dust + cobbled deepslate back into obsidian.
   > Chemistry: pressing powders into a solid below their melting point is sintering; it's how ceramics and many metal parts are made.
   > How: Reinforced Alloy, Elite Control Circuits (HV) and a steel casing (check JEI). Press U on it in JEI for every recipe.
17. **Challenge: Every Stage of Iron**: `mekanism:crystal_iron`; `mekanism:shard_iron`; `mekanism:clump_iron`; `mekanism:dirty_dust_iron` *(after: Factories for the Ore Line, 5x Ore: Dissolution)*
   > What: the full 5x chain, one stage of each: crystal (5x) → shard (4x) → clump (3x) → dirty dust → dust.
   > Chemistry: sulfuric acid dissolves the iron oxide into iron sulfate (Fe₂O₃ + 3H₂SO₄ → Fe₂(SO₄)₃ + 3H₂O). Washing rinses out insoluble rock, and crystallising pulls pure salt back out of solution.
   > How: dissolve, wash and crystallise, then inject crystals with HCl, purify shards with O₂, crush clumps. Dirty dust goes to the MI Centrifuge for byproducts.
   > Tip: each stage can also be fed raw ore directly, so a half-built line still gives 3x or 4x.
18. **Pigments**: `mekanism:pigment_extractor`; `mekanism:pigment_mixer`; `mekanism:painting_machine` *(after: Steel Casing, MV: Aluminum, HV: Digital Circuits)*
   > What: the Pigment Extractor pulls coloured pigment out of dyes; the Painting Machine applies it to blocks and items.
   > Chemistry: a pigment's colour comes from the light its molecules absorb: indigo absorbs orange-red light, so it looks blue.
   > How: the extractor needs Basic Circuits; the Painting Machine needs an Advanced Control Circuit (MV).
19. **Enriched Infusion**: 1x any of `item_tag(mekanism:enriched)` *(after: Enrichment Chamber)*
   > What: the Enrichment Chamber turns coal, charcoal and redstone into enriched forms. One enriched item gives the Metallurgic Infuser far more infuse than the raw material.
   > Chemistry: charcoal is nearly pure carbon left after heating wood without air (pyrolysis). Enriching it is like refining coal into coke: less ash, more carbon per gram.
   > How: crush charcoal into Charcoal Dust in the Crusher, then put coal, charcoal or redstone through the Enrichment Chamber (check JEI).
   > Tip: feed enriched items into the infuser's left slot: one stack lasts a long time.
20. **Obsidian Dusts**: `mekanism:dust_refined_obsidian`; 4x `mekanism:dust_obsidian` *(after: Crusher)*
   > What: obsidian dust, and refined obsidian dust made by infusing it with diamond. Refined obsidian dust becomes Atomic Alloy and refined obsidian ingots.
   > Chemistry: obsidian is volcanic glass, mostly SiO₂ (about 70%) with aluminium, iron and alkali oxides, frozen before it could crystallise.
   > How: crush obsidian in the Crusher, then Metallurgic Infuser: obsidian dust + diamond infusion → refined obsidian dust (check JEI).
   > Tip: a Combiner can turn spare obsidian dust back into obsidian later.
21. **Bio Fuel**: `mekanism:bio_fuel` *(after: Crusher)*
   > What: bio fuel is crushed plant matter. It burns in the Bio-Generator and is the start of the substrate line in the PRC.
   > Chemistry: plants store sunlight as sugars and cellulose: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂. Burning or digesting them gives that energy back.
   > How: put seeds, saplings, crops or other plant items into the Crusher (press U on Bio Fuel in JEI to see what counts).
   > Tip: a Mystical Agriculture or Farmer's Delight farm feeding a Crusher makes it renewable.
22. **Pigment Mixer**: `mekanism:pigment_mixer` *(after: Pigments)*
   > What: mixes two pigments into a new one, for colours no single dye gives.
   > Chemistry: pigments mix subtractively: each absorbs part of the spectrum, so yellow + cyan leaves only green to reflect.
   > How: Reinforced Alloy, HDPE rods, a steel casing and Elite Control Circuits (HV). Check JEI.
23. **Steel Casing**: `mekanism:steel_casing` *(after: Steel, Mekanism Circuits)*
   > A steel shell, ready for a purpose. You remember building with intent.
   > What: the Steel Casing is the body of every Mekanism machine on this page.
   > How: steel ingots, glass and an osmium ingot (check JEI).
   > Tip: every machine below starts from one casing. Make several at once.
24. **Enrichment Chamber**: `mekanism:enrichment_chamber` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: the Enrichment Chamber turns one ore into two dusts, and enriches coal, redstone and diamonds for the infuser.
   > How: redstone, a Basic Control Circuit and a steel casing (check JEI).
   > Tip: 2x is the cap before acids in this pack. The 3x, 4x and 5x lines are below.
25. **Crusher**: `mekanism:crusher` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: the Crusher grinds ingots into dust, stone into gravel and plants into bio fuel.
   > How: redstone, a Basic Control Circuit, lava buckets and a steel casing (check JEI).
   > Tip: it is the last step of the 3x line: clumps go in, dirty dust comes out.
26. **Osmium Compressor**: `mekanism:osmium_compressor` *(after: Advanced Control Circuit)*
   > What: the Osmium Compressor presses a dust together with osmium into a refined ingot: refined obsidian or refined glowstone.
   > How: an Advanced Control Circuit, alloys and a steel casing (check JEI). Osmium ingots go in its fuel slot.
   > Tip: one osmium ingot feeds many operations.
27. **Purification Chamber**: `mekanism:purification_chamber` *(after: Advanced Control Circuit, Enrichment Chamber)*
   > What: the Purification Chamber uses oxygen to turn ore into clumps, three per ore.
   > Chemistry: oxygen attacks the ore's surface and loosens the metal-bearing grains from the rock around them.
   > How: an Advanced Control Circuit (MV), an Enrichment Chamber and osmium (check JEI). Feed it O₂ from an Electrolytic Separator.
28. **Chemical Injection Chamber**: `mekanism:chemical_injection_chamber` *(after: Purification Chamber)*
   > What: the Injection Chamber uses hydrogen chloride to turn ore into shards, four per ore.
   > Chemistry: HCl dissolves metal oxides into chlorides (for example FeO + 2HCl → FeCl₂ + H₂O), which frees more metal from each ore.
   > How: a Purification Chamber, gold and circuits (check JEI; MV in this pack). Feed it HCl from a Chemical Infuser.
29. **Chemical Washer**: `mekanism:chemical_washer` *(after: Chemical Dissolution Chamber)*
   > What: the Washer cleans dirty ore slurry into clean slurry with water.
   > Chemistry: washing removes the insoluble rock and gangue that the acid left behind.
   > How: an Advanced Control Circuit in this pack, a steel casing and a bucket (check JEI). Feed it water with an Electric Pump.
   > Tip: it is part of the 5x line, together with the Dissolution Chamber and Crystallizer.
30. **Chemical Dissolution Chamber**: `mekanism:chemical_dissolution_chamber` *(after: Advanced Control Circuit)*
   > What: the Dissolution Chamber dissolves ore in sulfuric acid into a dirty slurry, the first step of the 5x line.
   > Chemistry: H₂SO₄ turns metal oxides into soluble sulfates, so the metal leaves the rock as a solution.
   > How: an Advanced Control Circuit in this pack, a steel casing and chemical tanks (check JEI).
31. **Chemical Crystallizer**: `mekanism:chemical_crystallizer` *(after: Chemical Washer)*
   > What: the Crystallizer turns clean slurry into crystals, five per ore, and brine into salt.
   > Chemistry: crystallisation pulls a pure solid out of a saturated solution: as the solvent goes, the ions arrange into a lattice and leave impurities behind.
   > How: an Advanced Control Circuit in this pack, a steel casing and chemical tanks (check JEI).
32. **A Pile of Dust**: 1x any of `item_tag(c:dusts)` *(after: Crusher, Enrichment Chamber)*
   > What: any dust. Dust is the common middle step: ore and ingots become dust, and dust smelts into ingots.
   > Chemistry: grinding raises surface area, and reactions happen at surfaces, so powders react and melt faster than lumps.
   > How: put an ingot in the Crusher or an ore in the Enrichment Chamber.
33. **Thermal Evaporation Plant**: 33x `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_block`; `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_controller`; `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_valve` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: a tall multiblock that boils water down into brine, and brine into lithium.
   > Chemistry: salt pans work the same way: water evaporates and the dissolved salts stay behind at higher and higher concentration.
   > How: a 4x4 base of evaporation blocks, up to 18 high, with a controller and valves (layout in JEI). Heat makes it faster.
34. **2x: Enrich and Smelt**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:enrichment_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:elite_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_enriching_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:energized_smelter)item(mekanism:basic_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_smelting_factory))` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: the first ore line: ore into the Enrichment Chamber (2 dusts), dusts into the smelter.
   > How: an Enrichment Chamber and an Energized Smelter, or any factory of either. Join them with a transporter.
   > Tip: this is the pack's cap before acids. Every step up needs a gas.
35. **3x: Oxygen**: `mekanism:electric_pump`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:purification_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:elite_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_purifying_factory))` *(after: Steel Casing, 3x Ore: Oxygen)*
   > What: the 3x line starts with oxygen: pump water, split it, and feed the O₂ into a Purification Chamber.
   > Chemistry: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂. Keep the hydrogen: it's fuel and a reagent later.
   > How: an Electric Pump, an Electrolytic Separator and a Purification Chamber or Purifying Factory.
36. **3x: The Rest of the Line**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:crusher)item(mekanism:basic_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_crushing_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:enrichment_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:elite_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_enriching_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:energized_smelter)item(mekanism:basic_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_smelting_factory))` *(after: 3x: Oxygen)*
   > What: clumps go through the Crusher into dirty dust, the Enrichment Chamber cleans it, and the smelter finishes the ingots.
   > How: a Crusher, an Enrichment Chamber and an Energized Smelter (or their factories), all on one transporter line.
   > Tip: dirty dust can go to the MI Centrifuge instead for byproducts.
37. **4x: Brine and Chlorine**: `mekanism:electric_pump`; 33x `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_block`; `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_controller`; 2x `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_valve`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator` *(after: Steel Casing, 4x Ore: Hydrogen Chloride)*
   > What: the 4x line needs chlorine: an evaporation plant makes brine, and a separator splits it.
   > Chemistry: electrolysis of brine (the chlor-alkali process): 2NaCl + 2H₂O → Cl₂ + H₂ + 2NaOH. Mekanism gives you Cl₂ and sodium.
   > How: a pump into the evaporation plant, its brine into a separator. Keep the chlorine.
38. **4x: Hydrogen Chloride**: `mekanism:electric_pump`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator`; `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:chemical_injection_chamber` *(after: 4x: Brine and Chlorine)*
   > What: hydrogen from a water separator and chlorine from the brine separator meet in the Chemical Infuser to make HCl for the Injection Chamber.
   > Chemistry: H₂ + Cl₂ → 2HCl. In daylight the mix can react explosively; Mekanism keeps it tame.
   > How: a second pump and separator for H₂, a Chemical Infuser, and the Injection Chamber.
39. **4x: Shards to Ingots**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:purification_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:elite_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_purifying_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:crusher)item(mekanism:basic_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_crushing_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:enrichment_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:elite_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_enriching_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:energized_smelter)item(mekanism:basic_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_smelting_factory))` *(after: 4x: Hydrogen Chloride)*
   > What: shards go into the Purification Chamber and then down the 3x line: crush, enrich, smelt.
   > How: one of each machine (or its factory) on a transporter line.
   > Tip: one factory of each type keeps up with a basic injection chamber.
40. **5x: Sulfuric Acid**: `mekanism:dust_sulfur`; `mekanism:chemical_oxidizer`; `mekanism:electric_pump`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator`; `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:rotary_condensentrator` *(after: Steel Casing, 5x Ore: Dissolution)*
   > What: the 5x line runs on sulfuric acid: burn sulfur, oxidise it again, then add water vapour.
   > Chemistry: S + O₂ → SO₂; 2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃; SO₃ + H₂O → H₂SO₄.
   > How: Oxidizer (sulfur → SO₂), separator (O₂), Chemical Infuser (SO₃, then acid) and a Rotary Condensentrator for water vapour.
41. **5x: Dissolve, Wash, Crystallise**: `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:chemical_dissolution_chamber`; `mekanism:chemical_washer`; `mekanism:chemical_crystallizer` *(after: 5x: Sulfuric Acid)*
   > What: the acid dissolves ore into dirty slurry, the washer cleans it, and the crystallizer turns it into crystals.
   > Chemistry: leach, purify, crystallise: the same three steps real hydrometallurgy uses for copper, zinc and uranium.
   > How: one of each machine, joined by pressurized tubes. The washer needs water.
42. **5x: The HCl Stage**: 2x `mekanism:electric_pump`; 33x `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_block`; `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_controller`; 2x `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_valve`; 2x `mekanism:electrolytic_separator`; `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:chemical_injection_chamber` *(after: 5x: Dissolve, Wash, Crystallise)*
   > What: crystals go into the Injection Chamber, so the 5x line needs the whole HCl setup from the 4x line as well.
   > How: two pumps, the evaporation plant, two separators, a Chemical Infuser and an Injection Chamber.
   > Tip: if you built the 4x line, reuse it: just send the crystals in front of it.
43. **5x: The Full Line**: `mekanism:electric_pump`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:purification_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:elite_purifying_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_purifying_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:crusher)item(mekanism:basic_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_crushing_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:enrichment_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:elite_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_enriching_factory))`; 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:energized_smelter)item(mekanism:basic_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_smelting_factory))` *(after: 5x: The HCl Stage)*
   > Five from one. You remember when the world gave freely; now you make it give.
   > What: the last stage is the 3x line again: oxygen, purifier, crusher, enrichment, smelter.
   > How: a pump and separator for O₂, then one of each machine (or factory).
   > Tip: dirty dust can also go to the MI Centrifuge for byproducts.

### Mekanism: Pipes and Storage

*Mekanism, continued: Pipes and Storage*

1. **Configurator**: `mekanism:configurator` *(after: Steel)*
   > What: the Configurator sets which side of a Mekanism block takes input and gives output, ejects contents, and rotates blocks.
   > How: iron, an osmium ingot and steel. Sneak + right-click to change its mode; the side colours match the machine's GUI.
   > Tip: most "my machine won't take gas" problems are a side set to the wrong colour.
2. **Portable Teleporter**: `mekanism:portable_teleporter` *(after: Chargepad, Teleportation Core)*
   > What: a hand-held teleporter that jumps you to any teleporter frequency you own.
   > How: a Teleportation Core between two Energy Tablets and two basic circuits (check JEI). Charge it first.
   > Tip: the further the jump, the more energy it costs.
3. **Tier Installers**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_tier_installer)item(mekanism:advanced_tier_installer)item(mekanism:elite_tier_installer)item(mekanism:ultimate_tier_installer))` *(after: The Basic Tier)*
   > What: right-click a placed machine with a Tier Installer to turn it into the next tier, keeping its contents and settings.
   > How: the basic installer needs a Basic Control Circuit; the advanced one needs an Advanced Control Circuit (MV).
   > Tip: a plain machine plus a basic installer becomes a basic factory.
4. **Speed Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_speed` *(after: Structural Glass)*
   > What: slot them into any Mekanism machine. Speed upgrades make it work faster; energy upgrades cut its power use and enlarge its buffer.
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around osmium dust (speed) or gold dust (energy). A machine takes up to 8 of each.
   > Tip: speed upgrades raise power use faster than they raise speed. Balance every speed upgrade with an energy upgrade.
5. **Filter Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_filter` *(after: Structural Glass)*
   > What: the Filter upgrade goes in an Electric Pump. With it the pump pulls heavy water out of ordinary water blocks instead of plain water.
   > Chemistry: heavy water is D₂O: water whose hydrogen atoms carry an extra neutron. About 1 molecule in 6,400 in seawater has a deuterium atom in it.
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around tin dust (check JEI). One per pump.
   > Tip: heavy water is the start of deuterium, and later of fusion fuel.
6. **Moving Day**: `mekanism:cardboard_box` *(after: Precision Sawmill)*
   > What: a Cardboard Box made from sawdust. Right-click almost any block (even a full chest or a spawner) to pack it up and carry it.
   > Chemistry: cardboard is pressed cellulose fibre, the same polymer that makes up most of the sawdust.
   > Tip: boxes can't pick up everything; blocks on the mod's blacklist won't pack.
7. **Resistive Heater**: `mekanism:resistive_heater` *(after: Thermodynamic Conductors, Evaporation Ponds)*
   > What: the Resistive Heater turns FE into heat; the Fuelwood Heater burns furnace fuel. Thermodynamic Conductors carry the heat to where it's needed, such as a Thermal Evaporation Plant.
   > Chemistry: evaporation speeds up with temperature because more water molecules have enough energy to escape the surface. The conductors are copper in steel: copper conducts heat about 8 times better than steel.
   > How: heaters need a steel casing and a circuit or Energy Tablet; conductors are steel and copper (check JEI). Watch the plant's temperature in its GUI.
   > Tip: a hot plant in a desert biome runs much faster than a cold one in the snow.
8. **Salt and Sodium**: 16x `mekanism:salt` *(after: Resistive Heater, Mekanism Gases)*
   > What: brine from the evaporation plant crystallises into salt, and splits into sodium and chlorine in the Electrolytic Separator.
   > Chemistry: real sodium is made by electrolysing molten NaCl (2NaCl → 2Na + Cl₂, the Downs cell). Salt is also a classic HCl source: NaCl + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HCl.
   > How: Chemical Crystallizer: 15 mB brine → 1 salt. Electrolytic Separator: brine → sodium + chlorine. Salt also counts as a hydrogen chloride source in an HCl machine's chemical item slot (press U on Salt in JEI).
   > Tip: sodium is the coolant for the best fission setups (see Sodium Coolant on the Power and Beyond page).
9. **Dynamic Tank**: 24x `mekanism:dynamic_tank`; 2x `mekanism:dynamic_valve` *(after: Chemical Tanks, Portable Fluid Tanks, Mekanism Circuits)*
   > What: a hollow multiblock tank of any size from 3x3x3 up, for huge amounts of a fluid or a chemical.
   > How: dynamic tank blocks (steel and a bucket) for the frame, structural glass for walls, and valves to pipe in and out. The layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks in JEI.
   > Tip: one dynamic tank block is also a part in the PRC and the Chemical Oxidizer.
10. **Pressurized Reaction Chamber**: `mekanism:pressurized_reaction_chamber` *(after: Steel Casing, Mekanism Gases)*
   > What: the PRC reacts an item, a fluid and a gas together under pressure. It makes substrate, HDPE, plutonium and polonium pellets, and gasifies coal and wood.
   > Chemistry: pressure pushes gas molecules closer together so they collide with the other reactants more often. Le Chatelier: a reaction that shrinks gas volume is favoured by high pressure.
   > How: Basic Control Circuits, Infused Alloy, steel, an Enrichment Chamber, a Dynamic Tank and chemical tanks (check JEI). Press U on it in JEI for every recipe.
   > Tip: it often makes two products at once (an item and a gas). Give each output side its own pipe.
11. **Substrate**: 16x `mekanism:substrate` *(after: Pressurized Reaction Chamber)*
   > What: substrate is Mekanism's polymer seed: a little of it, with ethene and oxygen, becomes HDPE.
   > Chemistry: plant matter can become ethylene: real bio-ethylene is made by dehydrating bioethanol (C₂H₅OH → C₂H₄ + H₂O). Polyethylene is then thousands of C₂H₄ units joined on a catalyst.
   > How: PRC: 2 bio fuel + water + hydrogen → substrate + ethene. Then substrate + water + ethene → 8 substrate (plus a little O₂). Check JEI for amounts.
   > Tip: MI ethylene is tagged as ethene in this pack, so your distillation tower can feed this line too.
12. **HDPE Parts**: 8x `mekanism:hdpe_sheet`; 2x `mekanism:hdpe_rod`; 4x `mekanism:hdpe_stick` *(after: Substrate, HDPE)*
   > What: HDPE pellets shaped into sheets, rods and sticks: parts for the Solar Neutron Activator, module bases, the MekaSuit and the Meka-Tool.
   > Chemistry: high-density polyethylene has straight chains with few branches, so they pack tightly. That makes it stiffer and stronger than the bendy LDPE in plastic bags.
   > How: PRC: substrate + ethene + oxygen → HDPE pellet (or use your MI line from the main path). Then shape pellets in the crafting grid (check JEI).
   > Tip: the MekaSuit alone eats dozens of sheets. Automate the pellets.
13. **Sulfur, the Key Element**: `mekanism:dust_sulfur` *(after: Chemical Infuser, Chemical Oxidizer, Chemical Dissolution Chamber, Enrichment Chamber, Rotary Condensentrator, Pressurized Reaction Chamber)*
   > Yellow dust, and every acid you will ever need. You remember sulfur as the first gift of volcanoes.
   > What: sulfur dust: the start of sulfur dioxide, sulfur trioxide and sulfuric acid, the gas behind Mekanism's 5x ore line.
   > Chemistry: the PRC can gasify coal (C + H₂O → CO + H₂, with a little O₂ burning to keep it hot) and leaves the coal's sulfur behind. The Oxidizer then burns S + O₂ → SO₂.
   > How: PRC with coal or coal dust, water and O₂ (check JEI), or crush sulfur from other sources. Every machine before this quest has a job in the acid line.
   > Tip: more sulfur is the usual bottleneck of a 5x line. Automate a source early.
14. **Challenge: The Full Chemical Plant**: `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:chemical_oxidizer`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator`; `mekanism:pressurized_reaction_chamber`; `mekanism:chemical_washer`; `mekanism:chemical_crystallizer`; `mekanism:chemical_dissolution_chamber`; `mekanism:isotopic_centrifuge`; `mekanism:solar_neutron_activator`; `mekanism:sps_port` *(after: Pressurized Reaction Chamber, Supercritical Phase Shifter)*
   > What: one of each of Mekanism's ten chemical machines, from the Chemical Infuser to an SPS port.
   > Chemistry: together they cover the unit operations of a real chemical plant: reaction, oxidation, electrolysis, washing, crystallisation, dissolution and isotope separation.
   > How: most are on the main path (see the links on the left). The washer, crystallizer and dissolution chamber are MV in this pack; the centrifuge needs Ultimate Control Circuits (EV).
   > Tip: an optional collection. Keep spares in a chest as you build each one.
15. **Logistical Transporters**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_logistical_transporter)item(mekanism:advanced_logistical_transporter)item(mekanism:elite_logistical_transporter)item(mekanism:ultimate_logistical_transporter))` *(after: Configurator)*
   > What: item pipes that carry stacks to the nearest inventory that will take them, and show the items moving.
   > How: steel around a Basic Control Circuit, 8 per craft.
   > Tip: a transporter's colour (set with the Configurator) only delivers into sides of the same colour.
16. **Logistical Sorter**: `mekanism:logistical_sorter` *(after: Logistical Transporters)*
   > What: pulls items out of the inventory behind it and sends them down transporters by filter: item, tag, mod or material.
   > How: iron, a piston and a Basic Control Circuit. It is also a part of the Digital Miner.
   > Tip: give each filter a colour, and the items arrive only at inventories with that colour.
17. **Diversion and Restriction**: 2x `mekanism:diversion_transporter`; 2x `mekanism:restrictive_transporter` *(after: Logistical Transporters)*
   > What: a Diversion Transporter opens or closes with redstone; a Restrictive Transporter is only used when no other path works.
   > How: steel and iron bars, plus redstone for the diversion type (check JEI).
   > Tip: a restrictive segment in front of an overflow chest makes it fill last.
18. **Faster Transporters**: 8x `mekanism:elite_logistical_transporter`; 8x `mekanism:ultimate_logistical_transporter` *(after: Logistical Transporters)*
   > What: higher tiers move bigger stacks, faster.
   > How: 8 transporters of the tier below around Reinforced Alloy (elite) or Atomic Alloy (ultimate).
   > Tip: the line only needs to be as fast as its slowest machine. Upgrade the trunk, not every branch.
19. **Formulaic Assemblicator**: `mekanism:formulaic_assemblicator` *(after: Logistical Transporters)*
   > What: saves a crafting recipe on a Crafting Formula and crafts it whenever ingredients arrive.
   > How: steel, a crafter, a chest, Basic Control Circuits and a steel casing (check JEI). Encode the recipe on a formula in its GUI.
   > Tip: handy for alloy blocks or circuits until your AE2 autocrafting is up.
20. **Mine, Not Yours**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:personal_barrel)item(mekanism:personal_chest))` *(after: Logistical Transporters)*
   > What: a Personal Chest only opens for its owner. The Security Desk sets who may use your Mekanism blocks: you, a trusted list, or everyone.
   > How: personal chest: steel, glass, chests and a Basic Control Circuit. Security desk: steel, glass, a Network Reader and Elite Control Circuits (HV) (check JEI).
   > Tip: on a shared server, lock your reactor controls.
21. **Dictionary**: `mekanism:dictionary` *(after: Chargepad)*
   > What: the Dictionary shows the tags of any item or block you click. The Gauge Dropper sucks a little fluid or gas out of a tank, or dumps a tank you don't want.
   > How: Dictionary: a book under a Basic Control Circuit. Gauge Dropper: osmium over glass panes (check JEI).
   > Tip: the Dictionary is the fastest way to find out which tag a filter needs (c:dusts/iron, c:ores and so on).
22. **Portable Fluid Tanks**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_fluid_tank)item(mekanism:advanced_fluid_tank)item(mekanism:elite_fluid_tank)item(mekanism:ultimate_fluid_tank))` *(after: Mechanical Pipes)*
   > What: Mekanism fluid tanks keep their fluid when broken, so you can carry a tank of acid to another machine. Each tier holds more and moves it faster.
   > How: basic: iron and Basic Alloy. Advanced: a basic tank ringed with iron and Infused Alloy (check JEI). They stack on top of each other and pass fluid down.
   > Tip: right-click a tank with a bucket to fill or empty it; tanks also fill buckets placed in their GUI.
23. **Elite Tanks**: `mekanism:elite_fluid_tank`; `mekanism:elite_chemical_tank` *(after: Portable Fluid Tanks)*
   > What: elite tanks hold far more than basic ones. The chemical tank is the gas version, for H₂, O₂, Cl₂ or SO₂.
   > How: the advanced tank ringed with Reinforced Alloy and iron (fluid) or osmium (chemical). Check JEI.
   > Tip: a chemical tank under an Electrolytic Separator smooths out its output while the rest of the line catches up.
24. **Liquefied Gases**: `mekanism:hydrogen_bucket`; `mekanism:oxygen_bucket` *(after: Water Vapor, Portable Fluid Tanks)*
   > What: the Rotary Condensentrator turns gases into liquids and back. Liquid hydrogen and oxygen fit in buckets and ordinary fluid tanks.
   > Chemistry: hydrogen boils at -253 °C and oxygen at -183 °C. Liquid oxygen is pale blue and is attracted to a magnet, because O₂ has two unpaired electrons.
   > How: set the condensentrator to condensing, feed it H₂ or O₂ from a separator, and pipe the liquid into a fluid tank. Fill buckets from the tank.
   > Tip: rockets in this pack burn fuel and oxygen; liquids are how big amounts travel.
25. **Acids by the Bucket**: `mekanism:hydrogen_chloride_bucket`; `mekanism:sulfuric_acid_bucket` *(after: Liquefied Gases, Contact Process 3: H₂SO₄, Hydrogen Chloride)*
   > What: the same machine liquefies hydrogen chloride and sulfuric acid, so other mods' machines (and the Undergarden catalyst) can use Mekanism's acids.
   > Chemistry: hydrogen chloride dissolved in water is hydrochloric acid; sulfuric acid is already a liquid at room temperature and boils at 337 °C.
   > How: Rotary Condensentrator on condensing mode, fed from your contact process or HCl line (check JEI).
   > Tip: one bucket is 1,000 mB, the same as 1,000 mB of the gas form.
26. **Advanced Transmitters**: 8x `mekanism:advanced_universal_cable`; 8x `mekanism:advanced_mechanical_pipe`; 8x `mekanism:advanced_pressurized_tube`; 8x `mekanism:advanced_logistical_transporter`; 8x `mekanism:advanced_thermodynamic_conductor` *(after: Logistical Transporters, Infused Alloy)*
   > What: every Mekanism transmitter has four tiers. Advanced ones carry several times more energy, fluid, gas, items or heat than basic.
   > How: eight basic transmitters around Infused Alloy make eight advanced ones (check JEI).
   > Chemistry: gas flow through a pipe rises with its cross-section and the pressure difference; Mekanism just lets you buy the bigger pipe.
   > Tip: upgrade the trunk line from the separator first; the branches can stay basic.
27. **Ultimate Universal Cable**: 8x `mekanism:ultimate_universal_cable` *(after: Advanced Transmitters)*
   > What: the top tier of power cable: tens of thousands of times what a basic cable carries.
   > How: elite cables around Atomic Alloy (elite cables use Reinforced Alloy). Check JEI.
   > Chemistry: real cables lose power as heat (P = I²R); fusion plants send power at high voltage so the current, and the loss, stays low.
28. **Electric Bow**: `mekanism:electric_bow` *(after: Chargepad)*
   > What: an FE-powered bow. Its fire mode sets arrows alight.
   > How: string, Infused Alloy and an Energy Tablet (check JEI). Charge it on a Chargepad.
   > Tip: it has no durability, only charge.
29. **Flamethrower**: `mekanism:flamethrower` *(after: Chargepad, Mekanism Gases, MV: Aluminum)*
   > What: a hand-held flamethrower that burns hydrogen gas. One mode smelts the blocks it hits.
   > Chemistry: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, about 286 kJ per mole of hydrogen. The flame is nearly invisible in daylight and leaves only water vapour.
   > How: tin, bronze, a basic chemical tank, flint and steel and an Advanced Control Circuit (MV). Fill it with H₂ from the separator's output or a chemical tank.
   > Tip: never point it at your storage.
30. **Electrolytic Separator**: `mekanism:electrolytic_separator` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: the Separator splits fluids with electricity: water into hydrogen and oxygen, brine into sodium and chlorine.
   > Chemistry: electrolysis of water: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂. Twice as much hydrogen as oxygen comes out, by volume.
   > How: redstone, iron, osmium and a Basic Control Circuit (check JEI). Pump water in, take each gas out on its own side.
31. **Chemical Oxidizer**: `mekanism:chemical_oxidizer` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: the Oxidizer burns a solid into a gas: sulfur into sulfur dioxide, and later uranium compounds for fission fuel.
   > Chemistry: S + O₂ → SO₂. Sulfur burns with a pale blue flame.
   > How: a Dynamic Tank block, a chemical tank and a circuit (check JEI).
32. **Chemical Infuser**: `mekanism:chemical_infuser` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: the Chemical Infuser reacts two gases: H₂ + Cl₂ into HCl, SO₂ + O₂ into SO₃, SO₃ + water vapour into sulfuric acid.
   > Chemistry: the contact process: 2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃, then SO₃ + H₂O → H₂SO₄. Sulfuric acid is the most produced chemical in the world.
   > How: a Basic Control Circuit, chemical tanks and a steel casing (check JEI).
33. **Rotary Condensentrator**: `mekanism:rotary_condensentrator` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: turns a gas into its liquid form and back. It also boils water into vapour for the acid line.
   > Chemistry: every gas liquefies when cooled below its boiling point; water vapour is just water above 100 °C.
   > How: glass, a chemical tank, a fluid tank and a circuit (check JEI). Toggle the mode in its GUI.
34. **HDPE Pellet**: `mekanism:hdpe_pellet` *(after: Bio Fuel, Pressurized Reaction Chamber, Rotary Condensentrator, HDPE)*
   > What: high-density polyethylene pellets, the plastic for sheets, rods and the late Mekanism gear.
   > Chemistry: n C₂H₄ → (C₂H₄)ₙ: thousands of ethene units join into long, straight chains.
   > How: PRC: substrate + ethene + oxygen → HDPE pellet (check JEI). Your MI polyethylene line from the main path is the other route.
35. **Structural Glass**: 4x `mekanism:structural_glass` *(after: Steel Casing)*
   > What: Structural Glass is the wall block of dynamic tanks, evaporation plants, boilers, turbines and the SPS.
   > Chemistry: glass is mostly SiO₂ cooled too fast to crystallise, so it stays clear.
   > How: glass and steel (check JEI).
36. **Energy Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_energy` *(after: Structural Glass)*
   > What: cuts a machine's energy use and enlarges its internal buffer.
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around gold dust (check JEI). Up to 8 per machine.
   > Tip: pair every speed upgrade with an energy upgrade.
37. **Muffling Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_muffling` *(after: Structural Glass)*
   > What: makes a machine quieter. Four make it silent.
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around wool (check JEI).
   > Tip: your ears will thank you in a room of 20 crushers.
38. **Chemical Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_chemical` *(after: Structural Glass)*
   > What: cuts the gas a machine uses per operation, in machines that take a secondary gas (purification, injection).
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around a gas ingredient (check JEI).
   > Tip: on an injection line it saves a lot of HCl.
39. **Stone Generator Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_stone_generator` *(after: Structural Glass)*
   > What: lets an Electric Pump make stone from the water and lava next to it.
   > Chemistry: lava is molten rock; water cools its surface below the melting point and it sets as stone.
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around water and lava (check JEI).
40. **Anchor Upgrade**: `mekanism:upgrade_anchor` *(after: Speed Upgrade)*
   > What: a machine with an Anchor upgrade keeps its own chunk loaded.
   > How: Infused Alloy and glass around diamond dust (check JEI).
   > Tip: cheaper than a Dimensional Stabilizer for one remote machine.
41. **Mechanical Pipes**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_mechanical_pipe)item(mekanism:advanced_mechanical_pipe)item(mekanism:elite_mechanical_pipe)item(mekanism:ultimate_mechanical_pipe))` *(after: Configurator)*
   > What: Mechanical Pipes carry fluids. Any tier counts.
   > How: steel and a bucket, 8 per craft (check JEI).
   > Tip: pipes pull only from blocks that push; set the source's side to output.
42. **Pressurized Tubes**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_pressurized_tube)item(mekanism:advanced_pressurized_tube)item(mekanism:elite_pressurized_tube)item(mekanism:ultimate_pressurized_tube))` *(after: Configurator)*
   > What: Pressurized Tubes carry Mekanism chemicals: gases, slurries and infuse types.
   > Chemistry: gases spread to fill any space, so a gas line must be sealed. Pressure drives the flow from the full end to the empty end.
   > How: steel and glass, 8 per craft (check JEI).
43. **Thermodynamic Conductors**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_thermodynamic_conductor)item(mekanism:advanced_thermodynamic_conductor)item(mekanism:elite_thermodynamic_conductor)item(mekanism:ultimate_thermodynamic_conductor))` *(after: Configurator)*
   > What: conductors carry heat between heaters, the evaporation plant and the boiler.
   > Chemistry: heat flows from hot to cold. Copper conducts heat about eight times better than steel.
   > How: steel and copper (check JEI).
44. **Chemical Tanks**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_chemical_tank)item(mekanism:advanced_chemical_tank)item(mekanism:elite_chemical_tank)item(mekanism:ultimate_chemical_tank))` *(after: Pressurized Tubes)*
   > What: Chemical Tanks store gases and keep them when broken. Any tier counts.
   > How: osmium and redstone (check JEI). Higher tiers ring the tank below with alloy.
   > Tip: one under each separator output keeps the line steady.
45. **Bins**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_bin)item(mekanism:advanced_bin)item(mekanism:elite_bin)item(mekanism:ultimate_bin))` *(after: Logistical Transporters)*
   > What: a Bin holds a large amount of one item type and keeps it when broken.
   > How: a chest, Basic Alloy and a circuit (check JEI). Left-click to take a stack, right-click to put one in.
   > Tip: good for cobblestone, dusts or anything you hoard by the thousand.
46. **Fuelwood Heater**: `mekanism:fuelwood_heater` *(after: Thermodynamic Conductors)*
   > What: burns any furnace fuel and gives heat to the conductors around it.
   > Chemistry: burning is fast oxidation: C + O₂ → CO₂ releases about 394 kJ per mole of carbon.
   > How: a steel casing, a furnace and a circuit (check JEI).
47. **Security Desk**: `mekanism:security_desk` *(after: Mine, Not Yours, Elite Control Circuit)*
   > What: sets who may use your Mekanism blocks: you, a trusted list, or everyone.
   > How: steel, glass and Elite Control Circuits (HV) (check JEI).
   > Tip: on a shared server, lock your reactor controls.
48. **Jetpack**: `mekanism:jetpack` *(after: Chargepad)*
   > What: a chest-slot jetpack that burns hydrogen.
   > Chemistry: hydrogen burns with oxygen into water: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O, with a lot of energy per gram.
   > How: steel, a basic chemical tank and circuits (check JEI). Fill it with H₂ from a separator.
   > Tip: hover mode is the safe one for building.
49. **Gauge Dropper**: `mekanism:gauge_dropper` *(after: Chargepad)*
   > What: sucks a little fluid or gas out of a tank, or dumps a tank you don't want.
   > How: osmium over glass panes (check JEI).
   > Tip: sneak + right-click empties the dropper itself.
50. **Free Runners**: `mekanism:free_runners` *(after: Chargepad)*
   > What: powered boots that stop fall damage and let you walk up full blocks.
   > How: string, Infused Alloy and an Energy Tablet (check JEI). Charge them on the Chargepad.
51. **Scuba Gear**: `mekanism:scuba_tank`; `mekanism:scuba_mask` *(after: Chargepad)*
   > What: a tank of oxygen on your back and a mask on your face: breathe underwater for a long time.
   > Chemistry: we need O₂ for respiration; a scuba tank just carries it with you.

### Mekanism: Power

*Boilers, turbines and fusion; Mekanism: More Machine; and Mekanism Extras' four tiers beyond ultimate.*

1. **Power and Beyond**: checkmark *(after: The Mekanism Way)*
   > The machines obey you now. You remember wanting more: more heat, more power, more than the last tier allowed.
   > What: the second Mekanism page. It covers the big power multiblocks (boiler, turbine, fusion), Mekanism: More Machine and Mekanism Extras.
   > How: each row opens when its main-path quest is done: fission for the boiler, the turbine casing, D-T fuel for fusion, yellowcake for Extras. Those quests are linked on the left.
   > Tip: the machines, factories, circuits and logistics are on the first Mekanism page.
2. **Thermoelectric Boiler**: 24x `mekanism:boiler_casing`; 6x `mekanism:structural_glass`; 4x `mekanism:boiler_valve`; `mekanism:pressure_disperser`; `mekanism:superheating_element` *(after: Boiler Valves, Boiler Core, Fission)*
   > What: a multiblock boiler that turns water into steam, heated by Superheating Elements (power) or by hot coolant from a fission reactor.
   > Chemistry: boiling water takes 2,260 J per gram, far more than heating it. That latent heat is what the turbine later turns back into work.
   > How: the layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks in JEI: casing walls, valves, a layer of pressure dispersers, and elements on the bottom.
   > Tip: a sodium-cooled fission reactor sends heated sodium here instead of boiling water itself.
3. **Sodium Coolant**: checkmark *(after: Fission Reactor Ports, Salt and Sodium)*
   > What: cool your fission reactor with sodium instead of water. It returns as superheated sodium, which the Thermoelectric Boiler uses to make steam before sending the sodium back.
   > Chemistry: sodium melts at 98 °C and boils at 883 °C, so it stays liquid at reactor temperatures without high pressure. Real fast reactors use it, and keep it away from water, which it reacts with violently.
   > How: sodium comes from brine in the Electrolytic Separator (see Salt and Sodium). Pipe it into the reactor, superheated sodium out to a boiler valve, and the cooled sodium back. Click to confirm once it runs.
   > Tip: one sodium loop feeds a much bigger boiler and turbine than water cooling does.
4. **Turbine Valves and Vents**: 2x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_valve`; `mekanismgenerators:turbine_vent` *(after: Steam and Waste Tanks, Industrial Turbine)*
   > What: valves feed steam in and take power out; vents let the spent steam leave through the walls above the rotor.
   > Chemistry: a turbine extracts work as steam expands and cools. The more vent area, the more steam can pass per tick.
   > How: valve: turbine casings around an Advanced Control Circuit (MV). Vent: casings around iron bars (check JEI).
   > Tip: the turbine GUI shows whether vent flow or blade count is your limit.
5. **Turbine Rotor**: 2x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_rotor`; 4x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_blade`; `mekanismgenerators:rotational_complex` *(after: Steam and Waste Tanks, Industrial Turbine)*
   > What: the moving parts inside an Industrial Turbine. More blades and coils mean more power from the same steam.
   > Chemistry: condensers turn spent steam back into water, so the loop reuses the same water over and over.
   > How: stack rotors with two blades each on the centre column, a Rotational Complex on top, then coils and condensers above. See Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks.
   > Tip: the turbine's GUI shows whether steam flow or blade count is the limit.
6. **Challenge: Every Generator**: `mekanismgenerators:heat_generator`; `mekanismgenerators:solar_generator`; `mekanismgenerators:advanced_solar_generator`; `mekanismgenerators:wind_generator`; `mekanismgenerators:gas_burning_generator`; `mekanismgenerators:bio_generator` *(after: Power and Beyond)*
   > What: one of each Mekanism generator: heat, solar, advanced solar, wind, gas-burning and bio.
   > Chemistry: between them: combustion, the photovoltaic effect, kinetic energy of air, and the energy stored in plant sugars by photosynthesis.
   > How: each one has its own quest on the Power page. The wind generator needs an Energy Tablet; the advanced solar is built from four basic solar generators.
   > Tip: none of these beats fission or fusion, but they never need fuel deliveries.
7. **Radioactive Waste Barrel**: `mekanism:radioactive_waste_barrel` *(after: Fission Reactor)*
   > What: a barrel that stores spent nuclear waste and other radioactive chemicals, and lets them slowly decay.
   > Chemistry: radioactive decay can't be sped up by chemistry; you can only wait out the half-life. Real spent fuel spends years in cooling ponds, then decades in dry casks.
   > How: check JEI for the recipe. Pipe waste into it with pressurized tubes; never vent it or break a full tube.
   > Tip: reprocessing waste into plutonium and polonium (the T6 page) is better than storing it.
8. **Advanced Induction**: `mekanism:advanced_induction_cell`; `mekanism:advanced_induction_provider` *(after: Power and Beyond, Induction Matrix, Advanced Control Circuit)*
   > What: cells set how much an Induction Matrix stores; providers set how fast power goes in and out. Swap basic ones for advanced and the same shell does far more.
   > Chemistry: the basic cells are lithium: Li has the lowest density of any metal and gives up its electron easily, which is why real batteries use it.
   > How: cell: four basic cells around an Advanced Energy Cube, with Energy Tablets in the corners. Provider: four basic providers around an Advanced Energy Cube, with Advanced Control Circuits (MV). Check JEI.
   > Tip: cells and providers go inside the matrix, not in its walls.
9. **Elite Induction**: `mekanism:elite_induction_cell`; `mekanism:elite_induction_provider` *(after: Advanced Induction, Elite Control Circuit)*
   > What: elite cells and providers, each again several times bigger than the advanced ones.
   > How: the same pattern one tier up: advanced cells around an Elite Energy Cube; advanced providers with Elite Control Circuits (HV). Check JEI.
   > Tip: a fission or fusion plant needs a big buffer for when the turbine spins down. Size the providers to your turbine's output.
10. **Ultimate Energy Cube**: `mekanism:ultimate_energy_cube` *(after: Power and Beyond, Atomic Alloy)*
   > What: the top Energy Cube: a lot of storage in one block you can pick up and carry, contents and all.
   > How: an Elite Energy Cube (Reinforced Alloy, gold) upgraded again with Atomic Alloy, Energy Tablets and diamonds (check JEI).
   > Tip: it's also the core of the ultimate induction cell and provider.
11. **Challenge: Ultimate Induction**: `mekanism:ultimate_induction_cell`; `mekanism:ultimate_induction_provider` *(after: Elite Induction, Ultimate Energy Cube, Ultimate Control Circuit)*
   > You remember holding the energy of a sun and not noticing the weight. This is close.
   > What: the top Induction Matrix parts. A matrix full of these stores more than any other block in base Mekanism.
   > How: elite cells or providers around an Ultimate Energy Cube, with Ultimate Control Circuits for the provider (check JEI).
   > Tip: a full matrix lets a fusion reactor keep your base running while you refuel or rebuild it.
12. **CNC Machines**: 1x any of `or(item(mekmm:cnc_stamper)item(mekmm:cnc_lathe)item(mekmm:cnc_rolling_mill))` *(after: Power and Beyond, Mekanism Circuits)*
   > What: Mekanism: More Machine adds CNC machines: the Stamper presses plates, the Lathe turns rods, the Rolling Mill rolls wire.
   > How: the CNC Stamper needs Basic Control Circuits, Basic Alloy, pistons and a steel casing. The Lathe also needs a Robit (check JEI). Any one counts.
   > Tip: MI's machines make most plates already. Use CNC machines for the mod recipes that list them in JEI (the stamper also prints AE2 processors).
13. **Recycler**: `mekmm:recycler`; 8x `mekmm:scrap` *(after: CNC Machines, MV: Aluminum)*
   > What: the Recycler grinds cheap blocks (stone, dirt, substrate) and sometimes leaves Scrap.
   > How: a Crusher, Advanced Control Circuits (MV), Infused Alloy and osmium (check JEI). About 1 stone in 6 gives a scrap.
   > Tip: 64 scrap compress into a Scrap Box, the first step towards UU-Matter. Start stockpiling early.
14. **Large Machines**: 1x any of `or(item(mekmm:large_heat_generator)item(mekmm:large_gas_burning_generator)item(mekmm:large_wind_generator)item(mekmm:large_chemical_infuser)item(mekmm:large_electrolytic_separator)item(mekmm:large_rotary_condensentrator)item(mekmm:large_solar_neutron_activator)item(mekmm:large_pigment_mixer))` *(after: CNC Machines, EV: Processing Units)*
   > What: More Machine's large machines do the work of many normal ones, such as the Large Electrolytic Separator or Large Chemical Infuser.
   > How: most need a Robit, steel blocks and ultimate-tier tanks or circuits (EV). Any one counts; check JEI for each.
   > Tip: the Large Solar Neutron Activator is a big help for polonium and tritium.
15. **UU-Matter**: `mekmm:replicator`; `mekmm:uu_matter` *(after: Recycler, Antimatter)*
   > Scrap, crystal, antimatter, and then anything. You remember when making matter was just a thought.
   > What: UU-Matter is More Machine's universal matter. The Replicator turns it back into items.
   > How: scrap boxes become Empty Crystals in the PRC (with fusion fuel and a special gas, check JEI). 64 crystals + antimatter in the Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer (an optional t7 quest) make one UU-Matter.
   > Tip: the Replicator needs Ultimate Control Circuits and Atomic Alloy. Check JEI for what it can copy.
16. **Presser**: `mekmm:presser` *(after: CNC Machines, HV: Digital Circuits)*
   > What: the Presser builds on the CNC Stamper and makes processors and other pressed parts (check JEI for its recipes).
   > How: a CNC Stamper with Elite Control Circuits (HV), Reinforced Alloy and pistons.
   > Tip: press U on the Presser in JEI to see what it makes.
17. **Planting Station**: `mekmm:planting_station` *(after: Recycler, HV: Digital Circuits)*
   > What: a machine that grows seeds and saplings indoors and outputs the harvest.
   > Chemistry: photosynthesis: 6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂, here powered by electricity instead of sunlight.
   > How: Elite Control Circuits (HV), Reinforced Alloy, bio fuel and a steel casing (check JEI).
18. **A Small Tribute**: `mekmm:author_doll` *(after: UU-Matter)*
   > What: a decorative doll of More Machine's author, compressed out of 64 UU-Matter and a breath of antimatter in the Osmium Compressor.
   > Tip: the mod's modeller has a doll too, made from UU-Matter gas instead. Thank you, modders.
19. **Ambient Gas Collector**: `mekmm:ambient_gas_collector` *(after: Recycler, EV: Processing Units)*
   > What: a machine that collects gas from its surroundings (check JEI and its GUI for what it gathers).
   > Chemistry: real air is 78% N₂, 21% O₂ and 1% argon; industry separates it by cooling it into a liquid and distilling it.
   > How: Atomic Alloy, an osmium block, an ultimate chemical tank and ultimate tubes (EV).
20. **Radiance**: 4x `mekanism_extras:dust_radiance`; 2x `mekanism_extras:alloy_radiance` *(after: Power and Beyond, Yellowcake)*
   > What: Mekanism Extras adds four tiers beyond ultimate: absolute, supreme, cosmic and infinite. Each needs a new alloy, starting with Radiance.
   > How: Osmium Compressor: glowstone dust + uranium oxide gas → Radiance Dust. Enrich it, then infuse Atomic Alloy with radiance (check JEI).
   > Tip: uranium oxide comes from oxidising yellowcake in the Chemical Oxidizer.
21. **Absolute Control Circuit**: 2x `mekanism_extras:absolute_control_circuit` *(after: Radiance)*
   > What: the first Extras circuit: an Ultimate Control Circuit between two Radiance Alloys.
   > How: craft it, or infuse an ultimate circuit with radiance in the Metallurgic Infuser.
   > Tip: absolute factories, cubes and tanks all start here.
22. **Supreme Control Circuit**: 2x `mekanism_extras:alloy_thermonuclear`; `mekanism_extras:supreme_control_circuit` *(after: Absolute Control Circuit)*
   > What: tier six. Its alloy is Thermonuclear: Radiance Alloy infused with thermonuclear material.
   > How: enriched radiance reacts with lava and molten thermonuclear in the PRC (check JEI for the full chain).
   > Tip: the circuit is an Absolute Control Circuit between two Thermonuclear Alloys.
23. **Cosmic Control Circuit**: 2x `mekanism_extras:alloy_shining`; `mekanism_extras:cosmic_control_circuit` *(after: Supreme Control Circuit, Antimatter)*
   > What: tier seven. Its alloy, Shining, needs enriched thermonuclear transmuted with antimatter.
   > How: Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer: enriched thermonuclear + antimatter → enriched shining. Then infuse Thermonuclear Alloy with it (check JEI).
   > Tip: the Nucleosynthesizer is slow; run it on fusion power.
24. **Infinite Control Circuit**: 2x `mekanism_extras:alloy_spectrum`; `mekanism_extras:infinite_control_circuit` *(after: Cosmic Control Circuit)*
   > Infinite, the circuit says. You remember when that word described you.
   > What: tier eight, the top of Mekanism Extras. Its alloy is Spectrum.
   > How: Osmium Compressor: enriched shining + antimatter → enriched spectrum; infuse Shining Alloy with it, then craft the circuit (check JEI).
25. **Absolute Factory**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism_extras:absolute_smelting_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_enriching_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_crushing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_compressing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_combining_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_purifying_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_injecting_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_infusing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_sawing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_oxidizing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_dissolving_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_washing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_crystallizing_factory)item(mekanism_extras:absolute_centrifuging_factory))` *(after: Absolute Control Circuit)*
   > What: Extras factories have more slots than ultimate ones, and Extras adds factory types base Mekanism lacks (oxidizing, washing, crystallizing, centrifuging...).
   > How: upgrade an ultimate factory with Absolute Control Circuits and Radiance Alloy, or use an Absolute Tier Installer. Any absolute factory counts.
   > Tip: the extra factory types are the big win: a washing or crystallizing factory speeds up the whole 5x line.
26. **Naquadah**: 8x `mekanism_extras:raw_naquadah` *(after: Supreme Control Circuit)*
   > What: Naquadah ore, added by Mekanism Extras. It is the fuel for the Naquadah Reactor.
   > Chemistry: naquadah is not real; it comes from the Stargate films. Every other material on this page is real chemistry.
   > How: Naquadah ore generates underground and in the End. Jade shows the block name when you look at it.
   > Tip: it processes like other Mekanism ores: dissolve, wash and crystallise for the best yield.
27. **Naquadah Reactor**: `mekanism_extras:naquadah_reactor_controller`; 16x `mekanism_extras:naquadah_reactor_casing` *(after: Cosmic Control Circuit, Naquadah)*
   > What: a fusion-style power multiblock from Mekanism Extras that runs on naquadah-based fuel.
   > How: casings are lead blocks transmuted with antimatter in the Nucleosynthesizer; the controller needs Cosmic Control Circuits. Layout: Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks.
   > Tip: the fuel chain starts with fluorinated naquadah-uranium fuel. Check JEI for each step.
28. **Robit**: `mekanism:robit` *(after: Refined Obsidian, Power and Beyond)*
   > What: the Robit follows you, picks up items, smelts and crafts. It is also a crafting part for the Digital Miner and several More Machine blocks.
   > How: Atomic Alloy, refined obsidian, steel, an Energy Tablet and a personal chest (check JEI). Place it on a Chargepad to recharge.
   > Tip: rename it with a name tag. It won't mind.
29. **Digital Miner**: `mekanism:digital_miner` *(after: Robit, Teleportation Core)*
   > What: a machine that mines out a large radius below it, taking only the blocks you filter for.
   > How: Atomic Alloy, a Logistical Sorter, a Robit, a Teleportation Core and a steel casing (check JEI). Set filters (tags like c:ores work), radius and height, then start it.
   > Tip: it uses a lot of power. Speed upgrades help, but bring Energy upgrades too. Rich deposits sit at metal-specific depths: set its height range to match.
30. **QIO**: `mekanism:qio_drive_array` *(after: Ultimate Control Circuit, Power and Beyond)*
   > What: Quantum Item Orchestration: drives in a drive array hold items, and dashboards, importers and exporters reach them wirelessly through a frequency.
   > How: the drive array needs a Teleportation Core and Ultimate Control Circuits (EV); the base drive needs an ultimate circuit too. Give every QIO block the same frequency.
   > Tip: AE2 is the pack's main storage. QIO is a good wireless add-on for a remote outpost.
31. **QIO Importer and Exporter**: `mekanism:qio_exporter`; `mekanism:qio_importer` *(after: QIO)*
   > What: importers pull items from the inventory they face into QIO; exporters push chosen items out. The Portable Dashboard opens your QIO from anywhere.
   > How: importer and exporter: lead, ender pearls, a Teleportation Core, an ultimate circuit and a (sticky) piston. The portable dashboard wraps a dashboard and a core in seven polonium pellets (check JEI).
   > Tip: an exporter with a filter on a machine's input is a tiny autocrafting line.
32. **QIO Drives**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:qio_drive_base)item(mekanism:qio_drive_hyper_dense)item(mekanism:qio_drive_time_dilating)item(mekanism:qio_drive_supermassive))` *(after: QIO)*
   > What: the Hyper-Dense QIO Drive holds far more than a base drive. Time-Dilating and Supermassive drives go further still.
   > How: each tier wraps the one below with a Teleportation Core and rarer materials (check JEI for each).
   > Tip: drive count matters as much as size: an array holds 12 drives.
33. **Meka-Tool**: `mekanism:meka_tool` *(after: Atomic Disassembler, Modules)*
   > What: the Atomic Disassembler grown up: one FE-powered tool that mines, digs, chops and fights, and takes modules for range, speed, silk touch, veinmining and more.
   > How: an Atomic Disassembler, a Configurator, HDPE sheets, Ultimate Control Circuits, polonium pellets and a Basic Induction Cell (check JEI).
   > Tip: it drinks power fast with big modules. Carry a charged energy cube or wear the MekaSuit.
34. **Reactor Safety**: checkmark *(after: Power and Beyond)*
   > What: a fission reactor that runs out of coolant heats up, and a hot enough reactor melts down and leaves radiation behind.
   > How: start at a low burn rate, keep coolant and waste flowing, and put a logic adapter on the reactor so redstone can stop it.
   > Tip: test a new design in creative or at burn rate 0.1 first.
35. **Yellowcake**: `mekanism:enrichment_chamber`; `mekanism:yellow_cake_uranium`; `mekanism:chemical_oxidizer` *(after: Power and Beyond, Yellowcake)*
   > What: yellowcake is uranium concentrate. Oxidised, it becomes uranium oxide, the start of fission fuel.
   > Chemistry: real yellowcake is mostly U₃O₈ and related uranium oxides, leached out of the ore and dried.
   > How: Enrichment Chamber: uranium → yellowcake. Chemical Oxidizer: yellowcake → uranium oxide gas.
36. **Hydrofluoric Acid**: `mekanism:rotary_condensentrator`; `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:chemical_dissolution_chamber`; `mekanism:fluorite_gem` *(after: Power and Beyond)*
   > What: hydrogen fluoride turns uranium oxide into uranium hexafluoride, the gas the centrifuge enriches.
   > Chemistry: CaF₂ + H₂SO₄ → CaSO₄ + 2HF. HF is one of the most dangerous acids there is: it passes through skin and attacks bone.
   > How: dissolve fluorite in sulfuric acid in the Dissolution Chamber; water vapour comes from the Rotary Condensentrator (check JEI).
37. **Fissile Fuel**: `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanism:isotopic_centrifuge` *(after: Yellowcake, Hydrofluoric Acid, Isotope Separation)*
   > What: the Chemical Infuser makes uranium hexafluoride; the Isotopic Centrifuge turns it into fissile fuel.
   > Chemistry: U-235 is only 0.7% of natural uranium. UF₆ is a gas, so centrifuges can separate the slightly lighter ²³⁵UF₆ molecules from ²³⁸UF₆.
   > How: uranium oxide + HF in the Chemical Infuser → UF₆; centrifuge → fissile fuel.
38. **Fuel and Control Rods**: `mekanismgenerators:fission_fuel_assembly`; `mekanismgenerators:control_rod_assembly` *(after: Fissile Fuel)*
   > What: fuel assemblies hold the fissile fuel; control rod assemblies sit on top of each column.
   > Chemistry: control rods soak up neutrons (boron and cadmium are the real choices), which slows the chain reaction.
   > How: check JEI. The reactor's inside is columns of fuel assemblies, each capped with a control rod.
39. **Fission Logic Adapter**: `mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor_logic_adapter` *(after: Power and Beyond, Fission)*
   > What: a reactor wall block that sends redstone (for high heat or low coolant) or takes it (to activate or SCRAM the reactor).
   > How: a fission reactor casing with redstone (check JEI). Swap it for one casing in the wall.
   > Tip: wire it to stop the reactor on high damage. It can save your base.
40. **Fission Reactor Ports**: 2x `mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor_port` *(after: Power and Beyond, Fission)*
   > What: ports are where pipes meet the reactor. Each one can be set to input, output waste or output coolant.
   > How: fission reactor casings around a chemical tank (check JEI). Switch modes with a Configurator.
   > Tip: use at least two: one for fuel and coolant in, one for steam and waste out.
41. **Fission Reactor**: 29x `mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor_casing`; 4x `mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor_port`; `mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor_logic_adapter`; `mekanismgenerators:fission_fuel_assembly`; `mekanismgenerators:control_rod_assembly` *(after: Fission Reactor Ports, Fission Logic Adapter, Fuel and Control Rods)*
   > The atom yields. You remember the old fire inside every stone.
   > What: a small fission reactor: casings, ports, a logic adapter and one column of fuel and control rods.
   > Chemistry: a U-235 nucleus that catches a neutron splits into two lighter nuclei, 2-3 neutrons and about 200 MeV of energy. The neutrons split the next nuclei.
   > How: the 3D layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks in JEI. Feed it fissile fuel and water (or sodium); take steam and nuclear waste out.
42. **Automatic SCRAM**: 2x `mekanismgenerators:fission_reactor_logic_adapter`; `minecraft:redstone`; `minecraft:redstone_torch`; 2x `minecraft:repeater` *(after: Fission Logic Adapter)*
   > What: one logic adapter watches for damage, the other shuts the reactor down. A torch and repeaters link them.
   > Chemistry: a real SCRAM drops every control rod at once; the chain reaction stops within seconds.
   > How: set one adapter to 'damage critical' output, the other to SCRAM input, and wire them together.
43. **Day Shift**: `minecraft:daylight_detector`; `minecraft:redstone` *(after: Fission Logic Adapter)*
   > What: a daylight detector on the logic adapter runs the reactor only by day (or only by night, inverted).
   > How: set the adapter to activation input and wire the detector to it.
   > Tip: a simple timer while you are still learning how your design behaves.
44. **Steam and Waste Tanks**: `mekanism:basic_chemical_tank` *(after: Fission Reactor)*
   > What: chemical tanks between the reactor and the rest of the plant hold steam and waste when something downstream stops.
   > How: osmium and redstone (check JEI). Higher tiers hold more.
   > Tip: a full waste tank stops the reactor safely; an empty one is a warning sign.
45. **Hazmat Suit**: `mekanism:hazmat_mask`; `mekanism:hazmat_gown`; `mekanism:hazmat_pants`; `mekanism:hazmat_boots` *(after: Radioactive Waste Barrel)*
   > What: a full hazmat set blocks radiation damage while you work near leaks.
   > Chemistry: most radiation from waste is alpha and beta: a layer of clothing and plastic stops it, but breathing it in does not.
   > How: HDPE and fabric pieces (check JEI). Wear all four.
46. **Turbine Upper Deck**: `mekanism:pressure_disperser`; `mekanismgenerators:electromagnetic_coil`; `mekanismgenerators:saturating_condenser` *(after: Steam and Waste Tanks, Industrial Turbine)*
   > What: above the rotor sit a layer of pressure dispersers, electromagnetic coils that make the power, and condensers that turn steam back into water.
   > Chemistry: a coil turning in a magnetic field makes current (Faraday's law). The condenser recovers the water as steam gives up its heat.
   > How: check JEI for each part; the layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks.
47. **Industrial Turbine**: 52x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_casing`; 64x `mekanism:structural_glass`; 2x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_valve`; 2x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_rotor`; 4x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_blade`; `mekanismgenerators:rotational_complex`; 8x `mekanism:pressure_disperser`; 9x `mekanismgenerators:electromagnetic_coil`; 9x `mekanismgenerators:saturating_condenser`; 12x `mekanismgenerators:turbine_vent` *(after: Turbine Valves and Vents, Turbine Rotor, Turbine Upper Deck)*
   > What: a full Industrial Turbine: casing and glass walls, valves, vents, a rotor with blades, and the upper deck.
   > How: the parts list above builds a 7x7 turbine; the layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks.
   > Tip: feed it the reactor's steam and send the condensed water back.
48. **Boiler Valves**: 4x `mekanism:boiler_valve` *(after: Sodium Coolant)*
   > What: valves let water, hot coolant and steam in and out of the Thermoelectric Boiler.
   > How: boiler casings around an Advanced Control Circuit (check JEI).
   > Tip: set each valve's mode with a Configurator.
49. **Boiler Core**: `mekanism:superheating_element`; `mekanism:pressure_disperser` *(after: Power and Beyond, Fission)*
   > What: superheating elements heat the boiler with electricity; the disperser layer splits water from steam.
   > How: check JEI for both.
   > Tip: with sodium cooling you can skip most of the elements.
50. **Atomic Disassembler**: `mekanism:atomic_disassembler` *(after: Power and Beyond)*
   > What: an FE-powered pickaxe, axe, shovel and sword in one, with several dig modes.
   > How: Atomic Alloy, an Energy Tablet and obsidian (check JEI).
   > Tip: it is the base of the Meka-Tool.
51. **QIO Dashboard**: `mekanism:qio_dashboard` *(after: QIO)*
   > What: the dashboard shows every item in your QIO and crafts from it.
   > How: check JEI. Give it the same frequency as your drive array.
52. **Portable QIO Dashboard**: `mekanism:portable_qio_dashboard` *(after: QIO Dashboard, Polonium)*
   > What: a hand-held dashboard that opens your QIO from anywhere.
   > How: a dashboard and polonium pellets (check JEI).
53. **Induction Port**: `mekanism:induction_port` *(after: Power and Beyond, Induction Matrix)*
   > What: ports are the matrix's connections. Switch each between input and output with a Configurator.
   > How: induction casing around an Elite Control Circuit (check JEI).
54. **Induction Cell**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_induction_cell)item(mekanism:advanced_induction_cell)item(mekanism:elite_induction_cell)item(mekanism:ultimate_induction_cell))` *(after: Power and Beyond, Induction Matrix)*
   > What: cells inside the matrix store the energy. Any tier counts.
   > Chemistry: the basic cell is built on lithium dust: lithium gives up its electron easily, which is why real batteries use it.
   > How: check JEI.
55. **Induction Provider**: 1x any of `or(item(mekanism:basic_induction_provider)item(mekanism:advanced_induction_provider)item(mekanism:elite_induction_provider)item(mekanism:ultimate_induction_provider))` *(after: Power and Beyond, Induction Matrix)*
   > What: providers set how much power the matrix can take in or give out per tick. Any tier counts.

56. **Induction Matrix**: 32x `mekanism:induction_casing`; 2x `mekanism:induction_port` *(after: Induction Port, Induction Cell, Induction Provider)*
   > What: a multiblock battery of any size from 3x3x3: casing walls, two ports, and cells and providers inside.
   > How: the layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks in JEI.

### Mekanism: Modules

*Mekanism: Power, continued: Modules*

1. **The Fusion Reactor**: `mekanismgenerators:fusion_reactor_controller`; `mekanismgenerators:laser_focus_matrix`; 36x `mekanismgenerators:fusion_reactor_frame`; 25x `mekanismgenerators:reactor_glass`; 3x `mekanismgenerators:fusion_reactor_port` *(after: Laser Focus Matrix, D-T Fuel and the Hohlraum, Fusion Reactor Port, D-T Fuel)*
   > What: the shell of the Fusion Reactor: frames, reactor glass, ports for fuel and output, and a Laser Focus Matrix to let the ignition laser in.
   > How: the 3D layout is in Just Enough Mekanism Multiblocks in JEI. The controller sits on top in the middle.
   > Tip: ports switch between input and output with a Configurator.
2. **Laser**: `mekanism:laser` *(after: Power and Beyond, Laser)*
   > What: lasers charge a Laser Amplifier, which fires a single huge pulse into the reactor to ignite it.
   > Chemistry: deuterium and tritium only fuse above about 100 million °C, when the nuclei move fast enough to beat their electric repulsion.
   > How: put a filled Hohlraum in the controller, aim the amplifier at the Laser Focus Matrix and fire it with a redstone signal. Then go to the Fusion quest.
   > Tip: once lit, the reactor sustains itself as long as fuel keeps coming.
3. **Fusion Logic Adapter**: `mekanismgenerators:fusion_reactor_logic_adapter` *(after: The Fusion Reactor)*
   > What: a reactor block that outputs redstone for things like ignition state, plasma temperature or low fuel.
   > How: a fusion reactor frame surrounded by redstone; swap one frame of the shell for it and pick the mode in its GUI.
   > Tip: wire "ready for ignition" to your laser amplifier to relight the reactor automatically.
4. **Modules**: 4x `mekanism:module_base`; `mekanism:modification_station` *(after: HDPE Parts, Polonium)*
   > What: module bases are the blank every MekaSuit and Meka-Tool module is built on. The Modification Station installs modules into your gear.
   > How: module base: an HDPE sheet in tin ingots and bronze nuggets (makes 2). Station: HDPE sheets, a chest, Ultimate Control Circuits (EV), a steel casing and a polonium pellet (check JEI).
   > Tip: press U on a Module Base in JEI to see every module and what each one needs.
5. **MekaSuit Pants**: `mekanism:mekasuit_pants` *(after: Antimatter Pellet, Modules)*
   > Four pieces, one will. You remember standing in fire and feeling only warmth.
   > What: the MekaSuit legs and boots, completing the armour started on the Tools page. Legs take movement and locomotion modules; boots take jump and fall protection.
   > How: netherite leggings / boots in HDPE sheets, Ultimate Control Circuits, polonium pellets and a Basic Induction Cell (check JEI).
   > Tip: the full suit shares one energy pool through its modules. Charge it on a Chargepad or with a charging module.
6. **Reprocessing Waste**: `mekanism:isotopic_centrifuge` *(after: Radioactive Waste Barrel, Isotope Separation)*
   > What: the Isotopic Centrifuge turns nuclear waste into plutonium.
   > Chemistry: in a reactor, U-238 catches neutrons and turns into Pu-239 over two beta decays. Reprocessing pulls it back out of the spent fuel.
   > How: pipe waste from the reactor into the centrifuge (check JEI).
7. **Plutonium Pellet**: `mekanism:pellet_plutonium` *(after: Reprocessing Waste)*
   > What: plutonium pellets go into the SPS, the Seed's chemistry and late recipes.
   > How: crystallise plutonium in the Chemical Crystallizer (check JEI).
   > Tip: every pellet started as reactor waste.
8. **Solar Neutron Activator**: `mekanism:solar_neutron_activator` *(after: Radioactive Waste Barrel, Solar Neutron Activator)*
   > What: the SNA uses sunlight to bombard a chemical with neutrons: nuclear waste into polonium, lithium into tritium.
   > Chemistry: Li-6 + n → He-4 + T (tritium). Bi-209 + n → Bi-210, which decays into Po-210.
   > How: it needs open sky above it (check JEI for the recipe).
9. **Polonium Pellet**: `mekanism:pellet_polonium` *(after: Solar Neutron Activator)*
   > What: polonium pellets power QIO, the MekaSuit, the SPS and more.
   > Chemistry: Po-210 is an alpha emitter with a 138-day half-life. Gram for gram it gives off about 140 W of heat.
   > How: SNA: waste → polonium, then crystallise it into pellets (check JEI).
10. **Laser Amplifier**: `mekanism:laser_amplifier` *(after: Laser)*
   > What: lasers charge the Laser Amplifier, which fires one huge pulse on a redstone signal.
   > How: check JEI. Aim the lasers into it, and it at the reactor's focus matrix.
11. **Laser Focus Matrix**: `mekanismgenerators:laser_focus_matrix` *(after: Laser Amplifier)*
   > What: the reactor wall block the ignition laser fires through.
   > How: reactor glass and redstone (check JEI).
12. **Deuterium**: `mekanism:electric_pump`; `mekanism:upgrade_filter`; `mekanism:electrolytic_separator` *(after: Filter Upgrade)*
   > What: a pump with a Filter upgrade pulls heavy water; the separator splits it into deuterium and oxygen.
   > Chemistry: 2D₂O → 2D₂ + O₂. Deuterium is hydrogen with one neutron.
   > How: Electric Pump + Filter upgrade over water, into an Electrolytic Separator.
13. **Tritium**: 33x `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_block`; `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_controller`; `mekanism:thermal_evaporation_valve`; `mekanism:rotary_condensentrator`; `mekanism:solar_neutron_activator` *(after: Solar Neutron Activator)*
   > What: brine boils down to lithium in the evaporation plant; the SNA turns lithium into tritium.
   > Chemistry: Li-6 + n → He-4 + T. Tritium is hydrogen with two neutrons and a half-life of about 12 years.
   > How: evaporation plant → liquid lithium → condensentrator → lithium gas → SNA.
14. **D-T Fuel and the Hohlraum**: `mekanism:chemical_infuser`; `mekanismgenerators:hohlraum` *(after: Tritium, Deuterium, D-T Fuel)*
   > What: deuterium + tritium in the Chemical Infuser make D-T fuel. A hohlraum filled with it starts the reaction.
   > Chemistry: D + T → He-4 + n + 17.6 MeV, the easiest fusion reaction to ignite.
   > How: fill the hohlraum with D-T fuel in a chemical tank's slot and place it in the controller (check JEI).
