   > How: mine gloomslate; it breaks into cobbled gloomslate. Smelt it back into smooth gloomslate.
37. **Bloom Berries**: `deeperdarker:bloom_berries` *(after: The Blooming Caverns)*
   > What: edible berries from the blooming caverns, the easiest food to find down here.
   > How: pick them from the blooming plants in the caverns.
38. **Sculk Vines**: `deeperdarker:sculk_vines` *(after: The Blooming Caverns, The Deeplands)*
   > What: vines of sculk that hang from the Otherside's ceilings.
   > How: cut them down in the deeplands or the blooming caverns.
39. **Ice Lily**: `deeperdarker:ice_lily` *(after: The Blooming Caverns)*
   > What: a pale flower of the blooming caverns.
   > How: pick one where it grows in the caverns.
40. **Blooming Moss**: `deeperdarker:blooming_moss_block` *(after: The Blooming Caverns)*
   > What: the moss that carpets the blooming caverns.
   > How: dig up a block of it.
41. **Gloomy Cactus**: `deeperdarker:gloomy_cactus` *(after: The Overcast Columns)*
   > What: a cactus that grows among the gloomy sculk of the overcast columns.
   > How: break one off where it grows.
42. **Sculk Tendrils**: `deeperdarker:sculk_tendrils` *(after: The Deeplands)*
   > What: sculk tendrils grow up from the deeplands' floor.
   > How: cut a few where they grow.
43. **Resonarium Plate**: 2x `deeperdarker:resonarium_plate` *(after: Sludge)*
   > What: the plate that upgrades diamond gear to resonarium.
   > Chemistry: turtle and armadillo scutes are built on keratin, the tough protein of hair, horn and hooves; its sulfur bridges (cysteine disulfides) make it hard.
   > How: four resonarium and four scutes (turtle or armadillo, any mix), shapeless.
44. **Resonarium Template**: `deeperdarker:resonarium_upgrade_smithing_template` *(after: Resonarium Plate)*
   > What: the smithing template that turns diamond gear into resonarium gear.
   > How: loot it from Ancient City chests, Trial Chamber reward chests, stronghold corridors or the Ancient Temple's top chest.
   > Tip: copy it with 7 diamonds and a resonarium (makes 2). Never use your last one.
45. **Resonarium Gear**: `deeperdarker:resonarium_pickaxe`; `deeperdarker:resonarium_chestplate` *(after: Resonarium Template)*
   > Stone that sings when struck. You remember tuning it to your own voice.
   > What: resonarium tools and armour: an upgrade over diamond that doesn't need netherite.
   > How: smithing table: resonarium template + diamond tool or armour piece + resonarium plate.
   > Tip: the rest of the set (axe, shovel, hoe, sword, helmet, leggings, boots) uses the same recipe.
46. **Warden Carapace**: 6x `deeperdarker:warden_carapace` *(after: The Warden)*
   > What: every Warden drops one to three carapace pieces (and its heart). The carapace is the core of reinforced echo shards.
   > How: kill Wardens, or loot Ancient City chests and the Ancient Temple.
   > Tip: one reinforced echo shard takes four carapace, four phantom membranes and an echo shard. Plan your Warden fights.
47. **Ancient Compass**: `deeperdarker:ancient_compass` *(after: Warden Carapace)*
   > What: a compass wrapped in Warden carapace. In the Otherside it points toward the nearest Ancient Temple.
   > Chemistry: an ordinary compass needle is magnetised iron or steel lining up with Earth's magnetic field.
   > How: a compass with four Warden carapace around it.
48. **Cover Me with Sculk**: `deeperdarker:warden_sword`; `deeperdarker:warden_axe`; `deeperdarker:warden_pickaxe`; `deeperdarker:warden_shovel`; `deeperdarker:warden_hoe` *(after: A Warden Blade, A Warden Tool)*
   > What: all five Warden tools and weapons at once.
   > How: the same smithing recipe on each netherite tool: one template and one reinforced echo shard per piece.
   > Tip: that's five more Wardens' worth of carapace, at least.
49. **Soul Materials**: 8x `deeperdarker:soul_dust`; 2x `deeperdarker:soul_crystal`; 4x `deeperdarker:sculk_bone` *(after: The Otherside)*
   > What: the Otherside's crafting drops: soul dust (snappers, leeches), soul crystals (stalkers) and sculk bones (shattered).
   > How: hunt in the Otherside; the Ancient Temple's chests hold some of each too.
   > Tip: the Bounty Board has quests for these mobs, so do both at once.
50. **Light in the Dark**: 4x `deeperdarker:gloomslate_light` *(after: Sculk Gleam)*
   > What: sculk gleam set in gloomslate makes a tidy lamp.
   > Chemistry: a glow stick makes cold light by chemiluminescence: hydrogen peroxide oxidises an oxalate ester, and the energy excites a dye that emits light.
   > How: one sculk gleam with four gloomslate around it.
51. **Gloomsherds**: 3x any of `or(item(deeperdarker:gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:brittle_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:dark_heart_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:listener_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:snapper_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:temple_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:transmission_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:ward_gloomsherd)item(deeperdarker:wayfinder_gloomsherd))` *(after: That Pot Moved)*
   > What: pottery sherds from the Otherside's makers. They decorate gloomslate pots, like vanilla sherds on decorated pots.
   > Chemistry: firing clay drives out water and partly melts its silicates into glass, which is why fired pottery survives for millennia.
   > How: collect any three. Amber blocks and the living pots of the Otherside carry them.
52. **Grime Bricks**: 8x `deeperdarker:grime_brick` *(after: Grime Ball)*
   > What: grime balls fire into grime bricks, a building block made from the Otherside's mud.
   > Chemistry: brick-making is old chemistry: heating clay above about 900 °C sinters its particles together into a hard ceramic.
   > How: smelt grime balls. Four grime balls also make a block of sculk grime.

### Metals of Legend

*Allthemodium, vibranium and unobtainium: metals no fire can win. A pad of steel and pearl opens three more worlds.*

1. **Beyond Netherite**: `minecraft:netherite_ingot` *(after: Netherite Pickaxe)*
   > There were metals you once named yourself. The first of them is waiting under the sculk.
   > What: netherite is the strongest ordinary metal. Every legendary metal on this page is mined with, or forged onto, netherite first.
   > How: four netherite scrap and four gold ingots make one ingot (check JEI). Hold one.
   > Tip: keep your netherite gear: each legendary template upgrades it rather than replacing it.
2. **Three Metals, Three Realms**: checkmark
   > What: allthemodium, vibranium and unobtainium form a ladder: each pickaxe mines the next ore. The Teleport Pad opens three more worlds.
   > How: none of these metals melts in a furnace here. Each one is refined in the MI Electric Blast Furnace by a real industrial route.
   > Tip: click the checkmark once you've read this.
3. **Under the Sculk**: find structure `minecraft:ancient_city` *(after: Beyond Netherite)*
   > What: Ancient Cities lie in the Deep Dark, and the Deep Dark is where allthemodium grows. The cities also hide its template.
   > How: the Explorer's Compass can find one. Sneak in and stand inside.
   > Tip: shriekers summon the Warden; break them quietly or go around.
4. **Allthemodium Ore**: 4x `allthemodium:raw_allthemodium` *(after: Mekanism Gases, Under the Sculk)*
   > What: the first of three legendary metals. It only grows in the Deep Dark biome, below Y 10, on cave ceilings (plain and deepslate ore).
   > How: a netherite pickaxe or better. Look up, not down. Sneak: the Deep Dark has shriekers and a Warden.
   > Tip: these ores must be mined by hand. A quarry, miner or other machine that breaks one destroys it and gets nothing. Ultimine is fine.
5. **Reduce It**: `allthemodium:allthemodium_ingot` *(after: Allthemodium Ore, Electric Blast Furnace)*
   > What: allthemodium won't melt in any furnace. Raw ore or dust has to be reduced in the Electric Blast Furnace.
   > Chemistry: carbothermic reduction, MO + C → M + CO: carbon pulls the oxygen off the metal. It's how iron, and MI's silicon, are made.
   > How: EBF with cupronickel coils, 32 EU/t: 1 raw allthemodium (or dust) + 1 coke dust → 1 ingot.
6. **Five from One**: 4x `allthemodium:allthemodium_crystal` *(after: Allthemodium Ore, 5x Ore: Dissolution)*
   > What: the mod comes with full Mekanism processing: oxygen 3x, hydrogen chloride 4x, sulfuric acid 5x, like every other ore.
   > Chemistry: sulfuric acid dissolves the ore into a slurry, water washes it, and crystals grow out as the solution concentrates.
   > How: Dissolution Chamber → Washer → Crystallizer → Injection → Purification → Crusher → Enrichment, then reduce the dust in the EBF.
   > Tip: without Fortune, silk-touch the ore: an ore block gives 5 crystals, a raw ore 3⅓. With Fortune III, mine it normally.
7. **The Teleport Pad**: `allthemodium:teleport_pad` *(after: Reduce It, Analog Circuit)*
   > What: one block that links two worlds. Placed in the Overworld it leads to the Mining dimension, in the Nether to The Other, in the End to The Beyond.
   > How: an ender pearl, 4 allthemodium nuggets, 4 MI steel plates and an analog circuit (check JEI).
   > Tip: stand on it, empty both hands and sneak + right-click. A return pad appears on the far side; it doesn't drop if broken, so leave it.
8. **A Pad at Home**: visit `minecraft:overworld` *(after: The Teleport Pad)*
   > What: a Teleport Pad placed in the Overworld opens the way to the Mining dimension.
   > How: you're probably here already: place a pad somewhere you'll find again.
   > Tip: put it inside your base; the return pad appears where you arrive.
9. **A Pad in the Nether**: visit `minecraft:the_nether` *(after: The Teleport Pad)*
   > What: a Teleport Pad placed in the Nether opens the way to The Other.
   > How: carry a pad through a Nether portal and place it.
   > Tip: build a little shelter round it: ghasts don't respect machinery.
10. **A Pad in the End**: visit `minecraft:the_end` *(after: The Teleport Pad)*
   > What: a Teleport Pad placed in the End opens the way to The Beyond.
   > How: carry a pad through the End portal and place it.
   > Tip: the End's outer islands are also where unobtainium grows.
11. **The Mining Dimension**: visit `allthemodium:mining` *(after: A Pad at Home)*
   > You built a world once just to dig in it. You kept the key.
   > What: a flat world in layers: grass and stone on top, deepslate from Y 128 down to 65, netherrack to Y 1, end stone, bedrock. The layers are packed with ore.
   > How: place a Teleport Pad in the Overworld and use it. Iron, emerald, diamond, gold and redstone are far richer here than at home, and ancient debris sits in the netherrack.
   > Tip: allthemodium grows here too (about one vein per chunk, in the deepslate layer). It is still hand-mined only. Light your tunnels: mobs spawn in the dark.
12. **Rich Seams**: 16x `minecraft:ancient_debris` *(after: The Mining Dimension)*
   > What: the Mining dimension's netherrack layer (Y 1 to 64) carries veins of ancient debris.
   > How: strip-mine the netherrack layer. A Mekanism or MI tool with a wide area helps.
   > Tip: every netherite pick and armour piece is an allthemodium upgrade waiting to happen.
13. **Brush the City**: `allthemodium:allthemodium_upgrade_smithing_template` *(after: Under the Sculk)*
   > What: the smithing template that upgrades netherite gear to allthemodium.
   > How: Ancient Cities hide Suspicious Clay where polished basalt would be. Brush it (vanilla brush) for the template.
   > Tip: copy it before you use it: template + 7 netherite ingots + deepslate makes 2.
14. **Allthemodium Pickaxe**: `allthemodium:allthemodium_pickaxe` *(after: Brush the City, Reduce It)*
   > What: the next rung of the ladder: netherite pick → allthemodium ore, allthemodium pick → vibranium ore.
   > How: smithing table: allthemodium template + netherite pickaxe + allthemodium ingot. Enchantments carry over.
15. **Allthemodium Sword**: `allthemodium:allthemodium_sword` *(after: Brush the City, Reduce It)*
   > What: the allthemodium sword, the first legendary blade.
   > How: smithing table: allthemodium template + netherite sword + allthemodium ingot. Enchantments carry over.
16. **Allthemodium Mace**: `allthemodium:allthemodium_mace` *(after: Brush the City, Reduce It)*
   > What: the vanilla mace, upgraded with allthemodium.
   > Chemistry: a falling mace turns height into energy: E = mgh, so doubling the drop doubles what it delivers on impact.
   > How: smithing table: allthemodium template + mace + a block of allthemodium (nine ingots; check JEI). A mace needs a heavy core from a Trial Chamber vault and a breeze rod.
   > Tip: pair it with a jump or a fall from a height; that's where a mace earns its keep.
17. **Allthemodium Armour**: 1x any of `or(item(allthemodium:allthemodium_helmet)item(allthemodium:allthemodium_chestplate)item(allthemodium:allthemodium_leggings)item(allthemodium:allthemodium_boots))` *(after: Brush the City, Reduce It)*
   > What: the boots cancel fall damage, the helmet refills your air underwater, the chestplate halves magic damage, and the set puts out fire on you.
   > How: smithing table, one template and one allthemodium ingot per netherite piece. Any one piece completes this quest.
   > Tip: no flight here. Your wings still come from chemistry.
18. **The Other**: visit `allthemodium:the_other` *(after: A Pad in the Nether)*
   > A world of endless night, with your old trees still standing. You remember planting them.
   > What: a dark, Nether-like realm of soul sand valleys, deserts and crimson and warped forests, with ancient, demonic and soul trees. Allthemodium and vibranium ores grow here.
   > How: place a Teleport Pad in the Nether and use it.
   > Tip: blocks inside The Other's structures can't be broken. Explore them; don't tunnel through them.
19. **The Ancient Pyramid**: find structure `allthemodium:ancient_pyramid` *(after: The Other)*
   > What: the pyramids of the soul sand valleys hold loot rooms and treasure chests (allthemodium and vibranium nuggets among them) and the Piglich.
   > How: an Explorer's Compass or a long walk through soul sand. Click once you're inside.
   > Tip: bring fire resistance; the soul sand valleys of The Other are no kinder than the Nether's.
20. **Piglich Heart**: `allthemodium:piglich_heart` *(after: The Ancient Pyramid)*
   > What: the Piglich spawns inside the Ancient Pyramid and drops one heart. Every alloy in this chapter needs one.
   > How: fight it in the pyramid; it keeps spawning inside the structure.
   > Tip: a Hostile Neural Networks data model for the Piglich farms hearts once you have the Simulation Chamber.
21. **The Dungeon**: find structure `allthemodium:dungeon` *(after: The Other)*
   > What: a sprawling dungeon of halls, a forge, a treasure room and a library. The library's chest holds the unobtainium template.
   > How: search The Other's warped forests. Click once you're inside.
   > Tip: Apotheosis bosses spawn in The Other. Gear up before you go deep.
22. **Vibranium Ore**: 4x `allthemodium:raw_vibranium` *(after: Allthemodium Pickaxe, A Pad in the Nether)*
   > What: the second legendary metal. It grows on cave ceilings in the Nether, from Y 64 up to the roof, and in The Other.
   > How: an allthemodium pickaxe or better. Hand-mined only, like allthemodium.
   > Tip: fly along the Nether ceiling with a light source; the ore shows up against the netherrack.
23. **The Kroll Route**: `allthemodium:vibranium_ingot` *(after: Vibranium Ore, A Hotter Furnace, Argon from Air)*
   > What: vibranium is refined like titanium and zirconium: through its chloride, never by melting the ore.
   > Chemistry: the Kroll process: MO₂ + 2Cl₂ + 2C → MCl₄ + 2CO, then MCl₄ + 2Mg → M + 2MgCl₂, under argon because the hot metal steals oxygen and nitrogen from air.
   > How: EBF with kanthal coils, 128 EU/t: raw vibranium (or dust) + coke dust + 2 magnesium dust + 500 mB chlorine + 50 mB argon → 1 ingot + 2 magnesium chloride dust.
   > Tip: the Alchemistry Compactor turns magnesium elements into magnesium dust. Keep the MgCl₂: the Dissolver splits it back into Mg and Cl.
24. **Brush the Bastion**: `allthemodium:vibranium_upgrade_smithing_template` *(after: A Pad in the Nether)*
   > What: the template that upgrades allthemodium gear to vibranium.
   > How: the treasure-room variant of a Bastion Remnant hides Suspicious Soul Sand among its blackstone. Brush it.
   > Tip: copy it: template + 7 allthemodium ingots + ancient stone (from The Other) makes 2.
25. **Vibranium Pickaxe**: `allthemodium:vibranium_pickaxe` *(after: The Kroll Route, Brush the Bastion)*
   > What: the only kind of pick (besides unobtainium) that can mine unobtainium ore.
   > How: smithing table: vibranium template + allthemodium pickaxe + vibranium ingot.
26. **Vibranium Sword**: `allthemodium:vibranium_sword` *(after: The Kroll Route, Brush the Bastion)*
   > What: the vibranium sword.
   > How: smithing table: vibranium template + allthemodium sword + vibranium ingot.
27. **Vibranium Mace**: `allthemodium:vibranium_mace` *(after: The Kroll Route, Brush the Bastion)*
   > What: the allthemodium mace, upgraded with vibranium.
   > How: smithing table: vibranium template + allthemodium mace + a block of vibranium (check JEI).
28. **Vibranium Armour**: 1x any of `or(item(allthemodium:vibranium_helmet)item(allthemodium:vibranium_chestplate)item(allthemodium:vibranium_leggings)item(allthemodium:vibranium_boots))` *(after: The Kroll Route, Brush the Bastion)*
   > What: the same perks as allthemodium armour, and the chestplate cuts magic damage to a quarter.
   > How: one vibranium template and ingot per allthemodium piece. Any one piece completes this quest.
29. **Vibranium-Allthemodium Alloy**: `allthemodium:vibranium_allthemodium_alloy_ingot` *(after: The Kroll Route, Piglich Heart)*
   > Two metals that refuse each other. You remember how to make them agree.
   > What: the first of the three legendary alloys.
   > Chemistry: refractory alloys melt too hot for any crucible, so industry blends the metal powders and consolidates them by sintering or arc-melting under argon.
   > How: Mixer: allthemodium dust + vibranium dust + Piglich Heart → 2 alloy dust. EBF (kanthal, 128 EU/t): 1 alloy dust + 100 mB argon → 1 ingot.
   > Tip: crush ingots to dust in the Mekanism Crusher.
30. **Unobtainium Ore**: 4x `allthemodium:raw_unobtainium` *(after: Vibranium Pickaxe, A Pad in the End)*
   > What: the last legendary metal, found only in the End highlands (the outer islands), on solid floors.
   > How: a vibranium pickaxe or better, by hand. It's rarer than the others: about three tries per chunk.
   > Tip: a Teleport Pad placed in the End also opens The Beyond, a quiet empty world to build in.
31. **The Fluoride Route**: `allthemodium:unobtainium_ingot` *(after: Unobtainium Ore, Hydrofluoric Acid, Sodium)*
   > What: unobtainium is refined like tantalum, the metal of capacitors and surgical implants.
   > Chemistry: HF digests the ore into a fluoride complex (K₂TaF₇ for tantalum), and molten sodium reduces it: K₂TaF₇ + 5Na → Ta + 2KF + 5NaF.
   > How: EBF (kanthal, 128 EU/t, 40 s): raw unobtainium (or dust) + 2 sodium dust + 250 mB hydrofluoric acid + 100 mB argon → 1 ingot.
   > Tip: HF eats glass and bone. In game it just needs Mekanism tanks; in a real lab it needs calcium gluconate on the bench.
32. **The Library Chest**: `allthemodium:unobtainium_upgrade_smithing_template` *(after: The Other)*
   > What: the template that upgrades vibranium gear to unobtainium.
   > How: find the dungeon in The Other's warped forests and loot the chest in its library room.
   > Tip: copy it: template + 7 vibranium ingots + end stone makes 2.
33. **Unobtainium Tool**: 1x any of `or(item(allthemodium:unobtainium_sword)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_pickaxe)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_axe)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_shovel)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_hoe))` *(after: The Fluoride Route, The Library Chest)*
   > What: any unobtainium tool or weapon. The unobtainium pick mines everything here, including ancient stone bricks and the alloy blocks.
   > How: smithing table: unobtainium template + vibranium tool + unobtainium ingot.
34. **Unobtainium Armour**: 1x any of `or(item(allthemodium:unobtainium_helmet)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_chestplate)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_leggings)item(allthemodium:unobtainium_boots))` *(after: The Fluoride Route, The Library Chest)*
   > What: the last armour upgrade. The unobtainium chestplate cuts magic damage to a tenth.
   > How: smithing table: unobtainium template + vibranium armour piece + unobtainium ingot. Any one piece completes this quest.
35. **Unobtainium Sword**: `allthemodium:unobtainium_sword` *(after: The Fluoride Route, The Library Chest)*
   > What: the unobtainium sword.
   > How: smithing table: unobtainium template + vibranium sword + unobtainium ingot.
36. **Unobtainium Mace**: `allthemodium:unobtainium_mace` *(after: The Fluoride Route, The Library Chest)*
   > What: the vibranium mace, upgraded with unobtainium.
   > How: smithing table: unobtainium template + vibranium mace + a block of unobtainium (check JEI).
37. **Forged in Annihilation**: `allthemodium:unobtainium_vibranium_alloy_ingot` *(after: The Fluoride Route, Vibranium-Allthemodium Alloy, Antimatter)*
   > Matter meets its mirror and both are gone, and the metals finally yield. You remember this fire. It was yours.
   > What: the unobtainium-vibranium alloy, one of the two rarest materials in the pack.
   > Chemistry: antimatter turns its whole mass into energy (E = mc²): one gram meeting one gram of matter releases about 1.8 × 10¹⁴ J, some 43 kilotons of TNT.
   > How: Mixer: unobtainium dust + vibranium dust + Piglich Heart → 2 alloy dust. EBF (128 EU/t): 8 alloy dust + 1 antimatter pellet + 1000 mB argon → 8 ingots.
   > Tip: one pellet fuses a whole batch of eight. Make the dust first, then spend the antimatter.
38. **Unobtainium-Allthemodium Alloy**: `allthemodium:unobtainium_allthemodium_alloy_ingot` *(after: The Fluoride Route, Vibranium-Allthemodium Alloy, Antimatter)*
   > What: the unobtainium-allthemodium alloy, the twin of the vibranium one.
   > How: Mixer: unobtainium dust + allthemodium dust + Piglich Heart → 2 alloy dust. EBF (128 EU/t): 8 alloy dust + 1 antimatter pellet + 1000 mB argon → 8 ingots.
   > Tip: run both alloys in the same antimatter session: each pellet fuses a batch of eight.
39. **The Beyond**: visit `allthemodium:the_beyond` *(after: A Pad in the End)*
   > What: a blank world with no features at all: a clean canvas for a demigod's building project.
   > How: place a Teleport Pad in the End and use it.
   > Tip: nothing spawns there to bother your builds, and nothing there needs mining. Bring your own blocks.

### Space

*The Moon, the planets and the air you bring with you.*

1. **Desh on the Moon**: 8x `ad_astra:raw_desh` *(after: One Small Step)*
   > You remember the Moon from above. Now you're standing on it.
   > What: desh ore is found only on the Moon. Desh blocks, engines and tanks build the Tier 2 rocket.
   > Chemistry: the Moon has no atmosphere and its days swing from about +120 °C to −170 °C, so bring oxygen.
   > How: mine desh ore on the Moon with an iron pickaxe or better (this pack sets its tier) and process it like any ore.
2. **Mars**: visit `ad_astra:mars`; `ad_astra:tier_2_rocket` *(after: Desh on the Moon)*
   > What: Mars holds ostrum ore, the metal for the Tier 3 rocket.
   > Chemistry: Mars is red because its dust is rich in iron(III) oxide, Fe₂O₃: rust. Its thin air is about 95% CO₂.
   > How: build the Tier 2 rocket from desh at the NASA Workbench, fuel it with diesel and launch.
3. **Ostrum**: 8x `ad_astra:raw_ostrum` *(after: Mars)*
   > What: ostrum ore is found only on Mars. It builds the Tier 3 rocket.
   > How: mine ostrum ore on Mars and process it. It needs a diamond pickaxe or better (this pack sets its tier).
   > Tip: grab some extra for the Tier 3 rocket's engine and tank.
4. **Heat Shielding**: `ad_astra:netherite_space_suit` *(after: Ostrum)*
   > What: Venus and Mercury are hot enough to kill in a normal space suit. The netherite space suit handles the heat.
   > How: check JEI for the netherite suit pieces. Fill it with oxygen at the Oxygen Loader.
   > Tip: the jet suit (later, check JEI) also handles the heat, and flies.
5. **Venus**: visit `ad_astra:venus`; `ad_astra:tier_3_rocket` *(after: Heat Shielding)*
   > What: Venus holds calorite ore, the metal for the Tier 4 rocket.
   > Chemistry: its atmosphere is about 96% CO₂ at roughly 92 times Earth's pressure, under clouds of sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄). A runaway greenhouse keeps it near 464 °C.
   > How: Tier 3 rocket from ostrum, plus your netherite space suit.
6. **Calorite**: 8x `ad_astra:raw_calorite` *(after: Venus)*
   > What: calorite ore is found on Venus. It builds the Tier 4 rocket, the only one that reaches another star.
   > How: mine calorite ore in the Venusian stone and process it like any ore. Only a netherite pickaxe (or better) can mine it in this pack.
   > Tip: Venus is hot and its rain is acid; keep the netherite suit on the whole time.
7. **Alien Metals**: 8x `ad_astra:desh_ingot`; 4x `ad_astra:ostrum_ingot`; 4x `ad_astra:calorite_ingot` *(after: Calorite)*
   > What: one metal from each world: desh (Moon), ostrum (Mars) and calorite (Venus). Each builds the next rocket tier.
   > How: process the raw ores; MI and Mekanism ore lines work on them too (check JEI).
   > Tip: the Dissolver can tell you what these metals break down into.
8. **Glacio**: visit `ad_astra:glacio`; `ad_astra:tier_4_rocket` *(after: Alien Metals)*
   > You remember stars that were yours to name. This one you'll have to visit first.
   > What: Glacio orbits Proxima Centauri, the nearest star to the Sun, about 4.2 light-years away. Unlike the others, it has breathable air.
   > How: build the Tier 4 rocket from calorite and launch.
9. **A Spare Breath**: `ad_astra:gas_tank` *(after: Breathe)*
   > What: a gas tank holds oxygen you can carry, to refill the suit far from your Oxygen Loader.
   > Chemistry: a resting adult breathes in roughly 550 litres of O₂ a day; your suit's tank is all that stands between you and vacuum.
   > How: iron plates and an iron rod (check JEI). Fill it in the Oxygen Loader like the suit.
   > Tip: the large gas tank holds much more and is a part in later machines.
10. **The Oxygen Can**: `ad_astra_giselle_addon:oxygen_can` *(after: A Spare Breath)*
   > What: the Giselle Addon's oxygen can stores oxygen and tops up the oxygen gear you're carrying.
   > How: iron plates around an iron rod (check JEI). Fill it with oxygen like a tank.
   > Tip: the addon also links Ad Astra to Mekanism and other mods; search its name in JEI to see what else it adds.
11. **Breathable Bases**: `ad_astra:oxygen_distributor` *(after: Mars)*
   > What: the Oxygen Distributor fills a sealed room with breathable air, so you can work without a helmet.
   > Chemistry: it makes oxygen from water with FE, the same idea as your Electrolytic Separator: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂.
   > How: check JEI. Seal the room completely; any gap stops it working.
12. **Is There Air?**: `ad_astra:oxygen_sensor` *(after: Breathable Bases)*
   > What: the Oxygen Sensor gives a redstone signal depending on whether the space around it has oxygen.
   > How: check JEI for the recipe, place it inside your sealed base and wire it to a lamp or alarm.
   > Tip: a light that goes out when the air does is the cheapest life support alarm there is.
13. **Water for Oxygen**: `ad_astra:water_pump` *(after: A Spare Breath, Mekanism Gases)*
   > What: Ad Astra's powered water pump feeds water into your pipes, so a base on the Moon can make its own oxygen.
   > Chemistry: electrolysis splits water: 2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂. Every 2 molecules of water give 1 of oxygen and 2 of hydrogen, which you can burn or store.
   > How: steel and desh plates, a gas tank and a hopper (check JEI). Pipe its water into a Mekanism Electrolytic Separator and the O₂ into an Oxygen Loader.
   > Tip: Ad Astra's ice shards are frozen water; the Moon and Mars both have ice shard ore.
14. **Netherite Oxygen Can**: `ad_astra_giselle_addon:netherite_oxygen_can` *(after: The Oxygen Can, Ostrum)*
   > What: the upgraded oxygen can holds much more oxygen than the iron one.
   > How: an oxygen can, a netherite ingot and ostrum plates in the crafting grid (check JEI). Its oxygen carries over.
   > Tip: on Venus every trip back to base costs time; carry more air instead.
15. **An Automated Launch Site**: `ad_astra_giselle_addon:fuel_loader`; `ad_astra_giselle_addon:rocket_sensor` *(after: One Small Step)*
   > What: the Fuel Loader takes piped fuel and fills any rocket or rover within a few blocks; the Rocket Sensor reports a nearby rocket's state to a comparator.
   > How: both are steel ingots and iron plates around a bucket or an observer (check JEI). Pipe diesel into the loader.
   > Tip: no more filling rockets by hand from buckets.
16. **Earth Gravity**: `ad_astra:gravity_normalizer` *(after: Desh on the Moon)*
   > What: the Gravity Normalizer gives an area Earth-like gravity, so your jumps behave in your Moon base.
   > Chemistry: the Moon's gravity is about 1/6 of Earth's, Mars about 3/8; you weigh less because they have less mass.
   > How: etrionic capacitors, a diamond block and desh plates (check JEI).
17. **The Rover**: `ad_astra:tier_1_rover` *(after: Desh on the Moon)*
   > What: a fuelled buggy for crossing big, airless plains quickly.
   > How: desh engine, desh blocks and plates, a large gas tank, a radio and wheels (check JEI). Fuel it with diesel.
   > Tip: low gravity makes it bounce; slow down on hills.
18. **The Moon Is Cheese**: 4x `ad_astra:cheese` *(after: Desh on the Moon)*
   > What: Ad Astra hides cheese ore on the Moon.
   > Chemistry: the real Moon is mostly silicate rock: oxygen, silicon, magnesium, iron, calcium and aluminum.
   > How: mine moon cheese ore. Eat responsibly.
19. **Lunarians**: find structure `ad_astra:lunarian_village` *(after: One Small Step)*
   > What: Lunarians are the Moon's villagers. Their villages stand on the lunar wastelands, with towers nearby.
   > How: explore the Moon until you find one, then walk into it. They trade like villagers.
   > Tip: the Explorer's Compass works on other planets too.
20. **Moon Dungeon**: find structure `ad_astra:moon_dungeon` *(after: One Small Step)*
   > What: a dungeon hidden under the lunar wastelands, with loot and hostile guards.
   > How: the Explorer's Compass can find one. Step inside.
   > Tip: bring a spare gas tank: dungeons take longer than you think.
21. **Temples of Mars**: find structure `ad_astra:mars_temple`; find biome `ad_astra:martian_canyon_creek` *(after: Mars)*
   > What: temples stand in the Martian wastelands and canyon creeks.
   > Chemistry: Mars's canyons were carved by liquid water long ago; today its low pressure makes surface water boil or freeze almost at once.
   > How: visit a canyon creek and find a temple (the Explorer's Compass helps).
22. **The Polar Caps**: find biome `ad_astra:martian_polar_caps`; 8x `ad_astra:ice_shard` *(after: Temples of Mars)*
   > What: Mars's polar caps are frozen; ice shard ore gives ice shards.
   > Chemistry: the real caps are water ice with a seasonal layer of dry ice (solid CO₂), which turns straight to gas in spring (sublimation).
   > How: visit the polar caps biome and mine ice shard ore (it's on the Moon too).
23. **The Pygros**: find structure `ad_astra:pygro_village` *(after: Venus)*
   > What: Pygros are piglin-like natives of Venus. Their villages and towers stand in the Venus wastelands.
   > How: find a village (the Explorer's Compass helps) and step inside. Wear gold, just in case.
   > Tip: Pygro brutes guard the towers; they hit hard.
24. **Infernal Barrens**: find biome `ad_astra:infernal_venus_barrens` *(after: Venus)*
   > What: the harshest of the Venusian biomes.
   > Chemistry: Venus is hotter than Mercury despite being twice as far from the Sun: its thick CO₂ atmosphere traps heat.
   > How: visit it in the netherite space suit. Fire resistance helps.
25. **Mercury**: visit `ad_astra:mercury` *(after: Venus)*
   > What: a scorched, airless world reachable with the Tier 3 rocket.
   > Chemistry: with almost no atmosphere, Mercury can't hold heat: about 430 °C by day and −180 °C at night.
   > How: Tier 3 rocket plus the netherite space suit.
26. **Mercury Deltas**: find biome `ad_astra:mercury_deltas` *(after: Mercury)*
   > What: Mercury's deltas, a dark landscape of scorched stone.
   > Chemistry: despite the name, the planet has no mercury metal; the element was named after the same god for its quick, flowing liquid.
   > How: land on Mercury and walk into the deltas.
27. **Peaks of Glacio**: find biome `ad_astra:glacio_ice_peaks`; find biome `ad_astra:glacio_snowy_barrens` *(after: Glacio)*
   > Air you didn't bring, under a sun that isn't yours. You remember this feeling: arriving.
   > What: Glacio's frozen peaks and snowy barrens, with its own trees and woolly rams.
   > How: visit both biomes. You can take your helmet off here.
   > Tip: Glacio has ordinary ores too (coal, iron, copper, lapis) in its own stone.
28. **In Orbit**: visit `ad_astra:moon_orbit`; visit `ad_astra:mars_orbit` *(after: Mars)*
   > What: every planet has an orbit dimension above it, where space stations are built.
   > Chemistry: in orbit you're falling around the planet all the time, which is why everything floats.
   > How: choose the orbit on the rocket's planet screen instead of the surface.
